# NOTE: acl_gemm currently returns EXIT_SKIP from init/run — ACL's NEGEMM
# crashes (SIGSEGV @0x518) under sandstone's fork-per-iteration model until
# fork-safety is fixed; the test is built and linked so the symbol is present
# and reports a clean skip. fisttp_arm is a real ACL-backed test.
# acl_sources is set above (empty when -Denable_acl=disabled or ACL not found).

# 1 compiler-rt test: soft-float __addsf3/__mulsf3/__divsf3 vs golden.
# (crt_sources is set in the probe-gated block above — empty when the
# clang-rt archive is absent on this build host.)

# Excluded — AOR libmathlib.a / libstringlib.a static archives are not present
# on this host, so these 3 tests would fail to link:
#   'aor_math.cpp',
#   'aor_string.cpp',
#   'cbw_arm.cpp',

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-library static libraries. Each is added to sandstone_tests so the test
# objects are linked into the final sdcshield binary. build_by_default:false
# keeps the objects out of the default ninja target until the main binary pulls
# them in (matches the pattern used by tests_crc / tests_arm64).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
gmp_tests_lib = static_library(
    'tests_arithmetic_arm_gmp',
    gmp_sources,
    build_by_default: false,
    include_directories: [
        framework_incdir,
        tests_common_incdirs,
    ],
    dependencies: [
        boost_dep,
        gmp_dep,
    ],
    cpp_args: [
        debug_c_flags,
        default_cpp_flags,
        default_cpp_warn,
        march_generic_flags,
        arm_cpp_flags,
    ],
)

acl_tests_lib = static_library(
    'tests_arithmetic_arm_acl',
    acl_sources,
    build_by_default: false,
    include_directories: [
        framework_incdir,
        tests_common_incdirs,
    ],
    dependencies: [
        boost_dep,
        acl_dep,
    ],
    cpp_args: [
        debug_c_flags,
        default_cpp_flags,
        default_cpp_warn,
        march_generic_flags,
        arm_cpp_flags,
    ],
)

crt_tests_lib = static_library(
    'tests_arithmetic_arm_crt',
    crt_sources,
    build_by_default: false,
    include_directories: [
        framework_incdir,

-# search path); the C++ tensor/operator headers ship only under a third-party
-# tree on the build host. Configured via -Denable_acl=auto|enabled|disabled and
-# -Dacl_incdir=/path (the header tree; empty = system default).
-# On 22.03/20.03 the ACL runtime is built against a newer libstdc++ (GLIBCXX_3.4.29+)
-# and won't link in the older toolchain; pass -Denable_acl=disabled there (the
-# container-build.sh driver does this via -D, no source sed needed).
-# When disabled (or auto + not found), acl_sources is empty and acl_dep is a
-# no-op declare_dependency(), so acl_tests_lib is an empty static lib that pulls
-# no ACL symbols — the 2 ACL tests simply aren't built.
+# Arm Compute Library: VENDORED source build (third-party/acl, Arm Compute
+# Library v23.02 built by its build.sh — first official pure-CMake release;
+# (gcc-toolset-10 via supplement-20.03-gcc10.sh) all satisfy). This replaces
+# the old scheme of linking the host's /usr/lib64/libarm_compute.so against a
+# separate header tree via -Dacl_incdir, which was ABI-broken on 22.03/20.03
+# (v20.02 runtime vs v22.11 headers, GLIBCXX mismatch) and disabled there.
+# The vendored build produces ONLY the arm_compute_core target (NEON runtime:
+# NEGEMM/NECast/Tensor — src/CMakeLists.txt:879/904/960); the sve/sve2/graph
+# targets are neither built nor linked, so no SVE machine code enters the
+# binary and non-SVE target machines stay safe.
+# Probe pattern identical to openssl/openblas/sleef: prefer
+# third-party/acl/install (built by build.sh); when absent under enable_acl=auto
+# the 2 ACL tests are simply not built (acl_sources empty, acl_dep a no-op
+# declare_dependency()); enable_acl=enabled makes a missing install/ a hard
+# error instead of a silent degrade.

-acl_incdir_opt = get_option('acl_incdir')
-acl_lib = cc.find_library('arm_compute', dirs : ['/usr/lib64'], required : (acl_enable == 'enabled'))

-if acl_found and acl_incdir_opt == ''
-  acl_found = cc.has_header('arm_compute/arm.h', required : false)

-      'acl_gemm.cpp',
-      'fisttp_arm.cpp',
+if acl_enable != 'disabled'
+  if run_command('test', '-f', acl_install / 'lib' / 'libarm_compute-core.a', check : false).returncode() == 0

Analyze ALL test cases in SDCShield (tests/common/ + tests/cpu/, both x86-64 reference and ARM64 port) and produce a defect list of tests whose implementation cannot actually stress / detect faults in the SDC unit they claim to cover — i.e., tests that pass trivially, stress the wrong thing, have vacuous golden comparisons, or misreport (pass/skip where they should do real work). Complete

- [x] Group D: library-math (eigen_*/openblas/sleef/pocketfft) — openblas golden=same lib call (deterministic, acceptable), eigen byte-exact vs first-run, sleef byte-exact vs libm — OK
- [x] Group E: common/special (mce_check, smi_count, ist, misc, jit, virtualization, arm-0102) — D6 (vmx family vacuous pass), D7 (BETA gating), D8 (ist honest skip), D10 (mite checksum)

# Task Plan: SDC Test-Case Audit — identify tests that cannot stress their target SDC unit

## Goal
Analyze ALL test cases in SDCShield (tests/common/ + tests/cpu/, both x86-64 reference and ARM64 port) and produce a defect list of tests whose implementation cannot actually stress / detect faults in the SDC unit they claim to cover — i.e., tests that pass trivially, stress the wrong thing, have vacuous golden comparisons, or misreport (pass/skip where they should do real work). Deliver an evidence-backed report (findings.md + audit report doc), one defect per entry with file:line proof.

## Next Step
Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) appended and complete; report at docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md. Fix ordering unchanged: D6 → D11 → D1/D2 → D3(acl) → eigen_svd_cdouble_sve/pocketfft-inverse.

## Current Phase
Complete

## Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) status
Complete (see ### Phase 5 above)

## Phases

### Phase 1: Inventory & Discovery
- [x] Enumerate all test dirs/files from tests/*/meson.build sourcesets (both arches)
- [x] Extract per-test metadata: name, quality_level, minimum_cpu, flags, description (DECLARE_TEST blocks)
- [x] Classify: x86-only / arm-only / common; real vs placeholder-skip vs stub
- [x] Record inventory in findings.md
- **Status:** complete

### Phase 2: Per-test SDC-coverage analysis
For each test: what hardware unit it claims to stress (FMA, SIMD, caches, compression engines, crypto, LSU, ALU...), what it actually computes, whether the golden comparison detects bit errors in that unit.
- [x] Group A: arithmetic/fma/vector/mesh/gather/atomic/arithmetic_arm (ALU/SIMD) — D1/D2 (fma tolerance), D3 (acl_gemm), D4 (tautological consistency), D5 (mesh sum)
- [x] Group B: cache/memory/lock/spinlock/load_port/arm64-mem (memory subsystem) — all have real memcmp/counter checks, OK
- [x] Group C: compression (zlib/zstd/ifs/isa-l) + crypto (openssl/ipsec/crc) — D11 (CRC family hw-vs-hw), compression OK (roundtrip verified)
- [x] Group D: library-math (eigen_*/openblas/sleef/pocketfft) — openblas golden=same lib call (deterministic, acceptable), eigen byte-exact vs first-run, sleef byte-exact vs libm — OK
- [x] Group E: common/special (mce_check, smi_count, ist, misc, jit, virtualization, arm-0102) — D6 (vmx family vacuous pass), D7 (BETA gating), D8 (ist honest skip), D10 (mite checksum)

# Copyright 2022 Intel Corporation.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# arithmetic_arm: tests that exercise ARM-optimised third-party libraries
# (GMP / Arm Compute Library / compiler-rt) to catch silent data corruption
# in the integer, floating-point and memory subsystems on ARM64 (Kunpeng 920).
#
# These tests are ARM-native: GMP, ACL and compiler-rt soft-float builtins are
# consumed on aarch64, and the whole subdir is entered only under the aarch64
# guard in tests/cpu/meson.build (see subdir('arithmetic_arm') there). On x86-64
# the sources are not compiled at all, so x86 behaviour is untouched.
#
# Dependency availability on this host (verified):
#   * GMP  .................. system package (/usr/include/gmp.h, /usr/lib64/libgmp.so)
#   * Arm Compute Library ... libarm_compute.so at /usr/lib64; headers under the
#                             third-party arm-opt-install tree (no /usr/include/arm_compute).
#   * compiler-rt builtins .. /usr/lib/clang/17/lib/aarch64-openEuler-linux-gnu/
#                             libclang_rt.builtins.a (soft-float __addsf3 et al.)
#
# The Arm Optimized Routines (libmathlib.a / libstringlib.a) static archives are
# NOT available on this host (only the .so versions ship, and the reference port
# links them statically to avoid a runtime GLIBC_2.38 dependency). The 3 AOR
# tests (aor_math.cpp, aor_string.cpp, cbw_arm.cpp) are therefore excluded
# below — they are listed as comments and not built, so there is no link error.
#
# Test IDs use an `_arm` suffix (adcx_arm, adox_arm, adcxlong_arm,
# adcx_adox_interleaved_arm) and are DISTINCT from the already-ported
# tests/cpu/arithmetic IDs (adcx, adox, adcxlong, adcx_adox_interleaved — no
# suffix, which use __int128). The _arm variants use GMP as the golden
# reference; both sets coexist without ID clash.

arm_cpp_flags = [
    '-march=armv8.1-a+crc+crypto',
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GMP: system package. Prefer pkg-config, fall back to find_library.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
gmp_dep = dependency('gmp', static : dep_static, required : false)
if not gmp_dep.found()
    gmp_lib = cc.find_library('gmp', required : false, static : dep_static)
    gmp_dep = declare_dependency(
        compile_args : ['-isystem', '/usr/include'],
        dependencies : [gmp_lib],
    )
endif

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Arm Compute Library: VENDORED source build (third-party/acl, Arm Compute
# Library v23.02 built by its build.sh — first official pure-CMake release;
# requires gcc >= 10.2 which 24.03 (12.3), 22.03 (10.3) and 20.03
# (gcc-toolset-10 via supplement-20.03-gcc10.sh) all satisfy). This replaces
# the old scheme of linking the host's /usr/lib64/libarm_compute.so against a
# separate header tree via -Dacl_incdir, which was ABI-broken on 22.03/20.03
# (v20.02 runtime vs v22.11 headers, GLIBCXX mismatch) and disabled there.
# The vendored build produces ONLY the arm_compute_core target (NEON runtime:
# NEGEMM/NECast/Tensor — src/CMakeLists.txt:879/904/960); the sve/sve2/graph
# targets are neither built nor linked, so no SVE machine code enters the
# binary and non-SVE target machines stay safe.
# Probe pattern identical to openssl/openblas/sleef: prefer
# third-party/acl/install (built by build.sh); when absent under enable_acl=auto
# the 2 ACL tests are simply not built (acl_sources empty, acl_dep a no-op
# declare_dependency()); enable_acl=enabled makes a missing install/ a hard
# error instead of a silent degrade.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
acl_enable = get_option('enable_acl')
acl_install = meson.current_source_dir() / '../../../third-party/acl/install'
acl_sources = []
acl_dep = declare_dependency()
if acl_enable != 'disabled'
  if run_command('test', '-f', acl_install / 'lib' / 'libarm_compute-core.a', check : false).returncode() == 0
    acl_dep = declare_dependency(
        include_directories : include_directories('../../../third-party/acl/install/include', is_system : true),
        link_args : ['-L' + acl_install / 'lib', '-l:libarm_compute-core.a'],
    )
    message('Using vendored ACL (third-party/acl/install)')
    acl_sources = files(
        'acl_gemm.cpp',
        'fisttp_arm.cpp',
    )
  elif acl_enable == 'enabled'
    error('enable_acl=enabled but third-party/acl/install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a not found — run third-party/acl/build.sh first')
  else
    message('ACL install/ not found under third-party/acl — run its build.sh to enable the 2 ACL tests.')
  endif
endif

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# compiler-rt builtins: static soft-float integer implementation (__addsf3,
# __subsf3, __mulsf3, __divsf3 ...). -Wl,--whole-archive prevents the linker
# from dropping the soft-float symbols as "unused".
# Probe-gated: the archive only exists where clang-rt is installed (this
# openEuler 24.03 host). In the 22.03/20.03 offline build containers the path
# does not exist and the unconditional link_args broke the final link
# ("c++: error: .../libclang_rt.builtins.a: No such file or directory").
# When absent, crt_sources is empty and crt_tests_lib is an empty static lib
# (same graceful-degrade pattern as acl_sources/openblas/sleef).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
crt_builtins_path = '/usr/lib/clang/17/lib/aarch64-openEuler-linux-gnu/libclang_rt.builtins.a'
if run_command('test', '-f', crt_builtins_path, check: false).returncode() == 0
    crt_builtins_lib = declare_dependency(
        link_args : ['-Wl,--whole-archive',
                      crt_builtins_path,
                      '-Wl,--no-whole-archive'],
    )
    crt_sources = files('crt_builtins.cpp',)
else
    crt_builtins_lib = declare_dependency()
    crt_sources = []
    message('libclang_rt.builtins.a not found at ' + crt_builtins_path +
            ' — the crt_builtins test is not built on this host.')
endif

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Source grouping. The 10 dep-available tests (7 GMP + 2 ACL + 1 compiler-rt)
# are grouped by library so each static_library pulls only the deps it needs.
# The 3 AOR tests are intentionally excluded (see header comment).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 8 GMP-backed tests: adcx_arm, adox_arm, adcxlong_arm, adcx_adox_interleaved_arm,
# bigint_mulx_arm, gmp_bigadd, gmp_bignum, operand_space_arm.
# operand_space_arm is the operand-space SDC stressor: it feeds the ARM64
# adder/carry-chain/multiplier a deterministic high-Hamming-distance operand
# table (0x0000...<->0xFFFF... alternating, walking-one) instead of uniform
# random, to force maximum per-cycle gate toggling (the "版图一.1 操作数空间"
# coverage dimension that uniform-random operands miss).
gmp_sources = files(
    'adcx_arm.cpp',
    'adcxlong_arm.cpp',
    'adox_arm.cpp',
    'adcx_adox_interleaved_arm.cpp',
    'bigint_mulx_arm.cpp',
    'gmp_bigadd.cpp',
    'gmp_bignum.cpp',
    'operand_space_arm.cpp',
)

# 2 ACL-backed tests: acl_gemm (NEON GEMM), fisttp_arm (FCVTZS cast).
# NOTE: acl_gemm currently returns EXIT_SKIP from init/run — ACL's NEGEMM
# crashes (SIGSEGV @0x518) under sandstone's fork-per-iteration model until
# fork-safety is fixed; the test is built and linked so the symbol is present
# and reports a clean skip. fisttp_arm is a real ACL-backed test.
# acl_sources is set above (empty when -Denable_acl=disabled or ACL not found).

# 1 compiler-rt test: soft-float __addsf3/__mulsf3/__divsf3 vs golden.
# (crt_sources is set in the probe-gated block above — empty when the
# clang-rt archive is absent on this build host.)

# Excluded — AOR libmathlib.a / libstringlib.a static archives are not present
# on this host, so these 3 tests would fail to link:
#   'aor_math.cpp',
#   'aor_string.cpp',
#   'cbw_arm.cpp',

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-library static libraries. Each is added to sandstone_tests so the test
# objects are linked into the final sdcshield binary. build_by_default:false
# keeps the objects out of the default ninja target until the main binary pulls
# them in (matches the pattern used by tests_crc / tests_arm64).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
gmp_tests_lib = static_library(
    'tests_arithmetic_arm_gmp',
    gmp_sources,
    build_by_default: false,
    include_directories: [
        framework_incdir,
        tests_common_incdirs,
    ],
    dependencies: [
        boost_dep,
        gmp_dep,
    ],
    cpp_args: [
        debug_c_flags,
        default_cpp_flags,
        default_cpp_warn,
        march_generic_flags,
        arm_cpp_flags,
    ],
)

acl_tests_lib = static_library(
    'tests_arithmetic_arm_acl',
    acl_sources,
    build_by_default: false,
    include_directories: [
        framework_incdir,
        tests_common_incdirs,
    ],
    dependencies: [
        boost_dep,
        acl_dep,
    ],
    cpp_args: [
        debug_c_flags,
        default_cpp_flags,
        default_cpp_warn,
        march_generic_flags,
        arm_cpp_flags,
    ],
)

crt_tests_lib = static_library(
    'tests_arithmetic_arm_crt',
    crt_sources,
    build_by_default: false,
    include_directories: [
        framework_incdir,
        tests_common_incdirs,
    ],
    dependencies: [
        boost_dep,
        crt_builtins_lib,
    ],
    cpp_args: [
        debug_c_flags,
        default_cpp_flags,
        default_cpp_warn,
        march_generic_flags,
        arm_cpp_flags,
    ],
)

sandstone_tests += [
    gmp_tests_lib,
    acl_tests_lib,
    crt_tests_lib,
]

# Task Plan: SDC Test-Case Audit — identify tests that cannot stress their target SDC unit

## Goal
Analyze ALL test cases in SDCShield (tests/common/ + tests/cpu/, both x86-64 reference and ARM64 port) and produce a defect list of tests whose implementation cannot actually stress / detect faults in the SDC unit they claim to cover — i.e., tests that pass trivially, stress the wrong thing, have vacuous golden comparisons, or misreport (pass/skip where they should do real work). Deliver an evidence-backed report (findings.md + audit report doc), one defect per entry with file:line proof.

## Next Step
Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) appended and complete; report at docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md. Fix ordering unchanged: D6 → D11 → D1/D2 → D3(acl) → eigen_svd_cdouble_sve/pocketfft-inverse.

## Current Phase
Complete

## Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) status
Complete (see ### Phase 5 above)

## Phases

### Phase 1: Inventory & Discovery
- [x] Enumerate all test dirs/files from tests/*/meson.build sourcesets (both arches)
- [x] Extract per-test metadata: name, quality_level, minimum_cpu, flags, description (DECLARE_TEST blocks)
- [x] Classify: x86-only / arm-only / common; real vs placeholder-skip vs stub
- [x] Record inventory in findings.md
- **Status:** complete

### Phase 2: Per-test SDC-coverage analysis
For each test: what hardware unit it claims to stress (FMA, SIMD, caches, compression engines, crypto, LSU, ALU...), what it actually computes, whether the golden comparison detects bit errors in that unit.
- [x] Group A: arithmetic/fma/vector/mesh/gather/atomic/arithmetic_arm (ALU/SIMD) — D1/D2 (fma tolerance), D3 (acl_gemm), D4 (tautological consistency), D5 (mesh sum)
- [x] Group B: cache/memory/lock/spinlock/load_port/arm64-mem (memory subsystem) — all have real memcmp/counter checks, OK
- [x] Group C: compression (zlib/zstd/ifs/isa-l) + crypto (openssl/ipsec/crc) — D11 (CRC family hw-vs-hw), compression OK (roundtrip verified)
- [x] Group D: library-math (eigen_*/openblas/sleef/pocketfft) — openblas golden=same lib call (deterministic, acceptable), eigen byte-exact vs first-run, sleef byte-exact vs libm — OK
- [x] Group E: common/special (mce_check, smi_count, ist, misc, jit, virtualization, arm-0102) — D6 (vmx family vacuous pass), D7 (BETA gating), D8 (ist honest skip), D10 (mite checksum)

===END-PWF-DATA kind=plan nonce=f206d84b634534aff356df51==="}}

# Task Plan: SDC Test-Case Audit — identify tests that cannot stress their target SDC unit

## Goal
Analyze ALL test cases in SDCShield (tests/common/ + tests/cpu/, both x86-64 reference and ARM64 port) and produce a defect list of tests whose implementation cannot actually stress / detect faults in the SDC unit they claim to cover — i.e., tests that pass trivially, stress the wrong thing, have vacuous golden comparisons, or misreport (pass/skip where they should do real work). ## Next Step
Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) appended and complete; report at docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md. Fix ordering unchanged: D6 → D11 → D1/D2 → D3(acl) → eigen_svd_cdouble_sve/pocketfft-inverse.

## Current Phase
Complete

## Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) status
Complete (see ### Phase 5 above)

### Phase 1: Inventory & Discovery
- [x] Enumerate all test dirs/files from tests/*/meson.build sourcesets (both arches)
- [x] Extract per-test metadata: name, quality_level, minimum_cpu, flags, description (DECLARE_TEST blocks)
- [x] Classify: x86-only / arm-only / common; real vs placeholder-skip vs stub
- [x] Record inventory in findings.md
- **Status:** complete

### Phase 2: Per-test SDC-coverage analysis
For each test: what hardware unit it claims to stress (FMA, SIMD, caches, compression engines, crypto, LSU, ALU...), what it actually computes, whether the golden comparison detects bit errors in that unit.
- [x] Group A: arithmetic/fma/vector/mesh/gather/atomic/arithmetic_arm (ALU/SIMD) — D1/D2 (fma tolerance), D3 (acl_gemm), D4 (tautological consistency), D5 (mesh sum)

- [x] Group E: common/special (mce_check, smi_count, ist, misc, jit, virtualization, arm-0102) — D6 (vmx family vacuous pass), D7 (BETA gating), D8 (ist honest skip), D10 (mite checksum)

# Task Plan: SDC Test-Case Audit — identify tests that cannot stress their target SDC unit

## Goal
Analyze ALL test cases in SDCShield (tests/common/ + tests/cpu/, both x86-64 reference and ARM64 port) and produce a defect list of tests whose implementation cannot actually stress / detect faults in the SDC unit they claim to cover — i.e., tests that pass trivially, stress the wrong thing, have vacuous golden comparisons, or misreport (pass/skip where they should do real work). Deliver an evidence-backed report (findings.md + audit report doc), one defect per entry with file:line proof.

## Next Step
Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) appended and complete; report at docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md. Fix ordering unchanged: D6 → D11 → D1/D2 → D3(acl) → eigen_svd_cdouble_sve/pocketfft-inverse.

## Current Phase
Complete

## Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) status
Complete (see ### Phase 5 above)

## Phases

### Phase 1: Inventory & Discovery
- [x] Enumerate all test dirs/files from tests/*/meson.build sourcesets (both arches)
- [x] Extract per-test metadata: name, quality_level, minimum_cpu, flags, description (DECLARE_TEST blocks)
- [x] Classify: x86-only / arm-only / common; real vs placeholder-skip vs stub
- [x] Record inventory in findings.md
- **Status:** complete

### Phase 2: Per-test SDC-coverage analysis
For each test: what hardware unit it claims to stress (FMA, SIMD, caches, compression engines, crypto, LSU, ALU...), what it actually computes, whether the golden comparison detects bit errors in that unit.
- [x] Group A: arithmetic/fma/vector/mesh/gather/atomic/arithmetic_arm (ALU/SIMD) — D1/D2 (fma tolerance), D3 (acl_gemm), D4 (tautological consistency), D5 (mesh sum)
- [x] Group B: cache/memory/lock/spinlock/load_port/arm64-mem (memory subsystem) — all have real memcmp/counter checks, OK
- [x] Group C: compression (zlib/zstd/ifs/isa-l) + crypto (openssl/ipsec/crc) — D11 (CRC family hw-vs-hw), compression OK (roundtrip verified)

- [x] Group E: common/special (mce_check, smi_count, ist, misc, jit, virtualization, arm-0102) — D6 (vmx family vacuous pass), D7 (BETA gating), D8 (ist honest skip), D10 (mite checksum)

content.text:
fork 机制已完全厘清，这对 Task 2 是个**重要修正**：

**fracture 的“迭代”并不重新 fork**——`run_one_test_children` 只在**整个测试开始时** fork 一次（sandstone_run.cpp:1469），fracture 循环（1731-1776）在**同一子进程内**只是循环调用 `init_internal`（仅日志/温度，:599-605）再跑 4 圈。所以原 SIGSEGV 的真正根因不是“fracture 迭代 fork”——而更可能是 `NEScheduler` 在 `import_memory` 缺失时的内部状态问题，或旧版 ACL v20.02 的 bug。**vendored v23.02 + import_memory（fisttp_arm 已证活的模式）在 fork_each_test 下与 fisttp_arm 完全同构**——同一 fork 点、同一对象生命周期。Task 2 方案成立，且依据更强了。把这一发现记入 findings 并继续。

input.command:
cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; cat >> .planning/2026-09-18-sdc-test-case-audit-weak-coverage-defect/findings.md <<'EOF'

## Phase 5c — Task 1/2 执行中的关键机制澄清(fork 模型)

1. **fork 时序实测**(framework/sandstone_run.cpp): `run_one_test_children`(:1469) 在整个测试开始时 fork 一次 → 子进程内 `child_run` → `test_init`(:1161-1178) → worker 线程 `test_run` → `test_cleanup`,全部同一子进程。
2. **fracture_loop_count 不重新 fork**: fracture 循环(:1731-1776)在同子进程内只重跑 init_internal(:599, 仅 logging/温度),不 fork。原 acl_gemm SIGSEGV 注释里"fork-per-iteration"的归因不准确——真正差异更可能是旧 ACL v20.02 二进制自身的 allocator/scheduler bug。
3. **结论**: vendored v23.02 + import_memory(fisttp_arm 同款,同 fork 点同生命周期)使 acl_gemm 与 fisttp_arm 完全同构,fisttp_arm 能活则 acl_gemm 应能活——待实跑验证。
4. **v23.02 build 事实**: 纯 CMake,无 install 规则 → build.sh 手工布置 install 树(archive + arm_compute/ + support/ + half/ 头闭包);arm_compute_core 硬编码 -march=armv8.2-a+fp16(host 有 fphp/asimdhp,gcc 接受,探针编译 exit=0);NEGEMM.cpp/NECast.cpp/Tensor.cpp 都在 core 目标(:879/904/960),sve/sve2/graph 独立目标不编不链。
EOF
echo OK; echo; echo "=== vendored 库构建进度 ==="; for d in openblas sleef isa-l; do ls third-party/$d/install/lib/*.a >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$d OK" || echo "$d building..."; done

# Task Plan: SDC Test-Case Audit — identify tests that cannot stress their target SDC unit

## Goal
Analyze ALL test cases in SDCShield (tests/common/ + tests/cpu/, both x86-64 reference and ARM64 port) and produce a defect list of tests whose implementation cannot actually stress / detect faults in the SDC unit they claim to cover — i.e., tests that pass trivially, stress the wrong thing, have vacuous golden comparisons, or misreport (pass/skip where they should do real work). Deliver an evidence-backed report (findings.md + audit report doc), one defect per entry with file:line proof.

## Next Step
Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) appended and complete; report at docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md. Fix ordering unchanged: D6 → D11 → D1/D2 → D3(acl) → eigen_svd_cdouble_sve/pocketfft-inverse.

## Current Phase
Complete

## Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) status
Complete (see ### Phase 5 above)

## Phases

### Phase 1: Inventory & Discovery
- [x] Enumerate all test dirs/files from tests/*/meson.build sourcesets (both arches)
- [x] Extract per-test metadata: name, quality_level, minimum_cpu, flags, description (DECLARE_TEST blocks)
- [x] Classify: x86-only / arm-only / common; real vs placeholder-skip vs stub
- [x] Record inventory in findings.md
- **Status:** complete

### Phase 2: Per-test SDC-coverage analysis
For each test: what hardware unit it claims to stress (FMA, SIMD, caches, compression engines, crypto, LSU, ALU...), what it actually computes, whether the golden comparison detects bit errors in that unit.
- [x] Group A: arithmetic/fma/vector/mesh/gather/atomic/arithmetic_arm (ALU/SIMD) — D1/D2 (fma tolerance), D3 (acl_gemm), D4 (tautological consistency), D5 (mesh sum)
- [x] Group B: cache/memory/lock/spinlock/load_port/arm64-mem (memory subsystem) — all have real memcmp/counter checks, OK
- [x] Group C: compression (zlib/zstd/ifs/isa-l) + crypto (openssl/ipsec/crc) — D11 (CRC family hw-vs-hw), compression OK (roundtrip verified)
- [x] Group D: library-math (eigen_*/openblas/sleef/pocketfft) — openblas golden=same lib call (deterministic, acceptable), eigen byte-exact vs first-run, sleef byte-exact vs libm — OK
- [x] Group E: common/special (mce_check, smi_count, ist, misc, jit, virtualization, arm-0102) — D6 (vmx family vacuous pass), D7 (BETA gating), D8 (ist honest skip), D10 (mite checksum)

content.text: symlink 指向的 `.so.1.2.13`/`.so.1.5.5` 实体不在 devel rpm 里（在主包）——但系统主包已装这些实体（版本可能略不同，SP4 的 zstd 是 1.5.6、zlib 1.2.12）。链接器只需要 symlink+头；运行时用系统的 .so。不过 symlink 指向不存在的文件会导致 -l 失败。稳妥做法：把 symlink 重指向系统实际存在的库。

input.command: echo "=== 系统实际 .so ==="; ls /usr/lib64/libzstd.so* /usr/lib64/libz.so* 2>/dev/null | head -6; echo; echo "=== 重指 symlink 到系统实体 ==="; cd ~/boost-local/usr/lib64 && ln -sf /usr/lib64/libzstd.so.1 libzstd.so 2>/dev/null || ln -sf $(ls /usr/lib64/libzstd.so.1* | head -1) libzstd.so; ln -sf $(ls /usr/lib64/libz.so.1* | head -1) libz.so; ls -la libzstd.so libz.so; echo; echo "=== pkg-config 校验 ==="; PKG_CONFIG_PATH=~/boost-local/usr/lib64/pkgconfig pkg-config --modversion libzstd zlib
input.description: Repoint devel symlinks to system runtime libs

content.text: 失败原因清楚了：**gmp.h 缺失**（gmp-devel 也是系统 -devel 缺失，与 ACL 无关的环境问题，同 boost/zstd 一批）。同样免 root 方案补 gmp-devel。

input.command: cd /tmp && BASE="https://repo.openeuler.org/openEuler-24.03-LTS-SP4/everything/aarch64/Packages"; timeout 60 curl -sL "$BASE/" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '"gmp-devel[^"]*\.rpm"' | sort -u | head -3; P=$(timeout 60 curl -sL "$BASE/" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '"gmp-devel[^"]*\.rpm"' | sort -u | head -1 | tr -d '"'); echo "选: $P"; timeout 120 curl -sL -o gmp-devel.rpm "$BASE/$P" && file gmp-devel.rpm && cd ~/boost-local && rpm2cpio /tmp/gmp-devel.rpm | cpio -idm 2>/dev/null; ls ~/boost-local/usr/include/gmp.h ~/boost-local/usr/lib64/libgmp.so ~/boost-local/usr/lib64/pkgconfig/gmp.pc 2>&1
input.description: Download and extract gmp-devel

Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) appended and complete; report at docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md. Fix ordering unchanged: D6 → D11 → D1/D2 → D3(acl) → eigen_svd_cdouble_sve/pocketfft-inverse.

Complete

- [x] Group E: common/special (mce_check, smi_count, ist, misc, jit, virtualization, arm-0102) — D6 (vmx family vacuous pass), D7 (BETA gating), D8 (ist honest skip), D10 (mite checksum)

#!/bin/bash
# Build Arm Compute Library v23.02 as a static arm_compute-core for SDCShield
# (aarch64). Produces: install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a
#                      install/include/{arm_compute,support,half}/...
#
# Why v23.02: the first official pure-CMake release (v22.11 and earlier are
# scons-only; this host is offline for pip so scons is unobtainable). Its
# CMakeLists.txt requires gcc >= 10.2, which all three target OSes satisfy
# (24.03: 12.3, 22.03: 10.3, 20.03: gcc-toolset-10 = 10.3 via
# scripts/offline-build/supplement-20.03-gcc10.sh) — a single vendored version
# covers all three, replacing the old host-binary scheme (v20.02 .so against
# v22.11 headers, which was ABI-broken on 22.03/20.03 and disabled there).
#
# Why only the `arm_compute_core` target: the SDCShield tests use the NEON
# runtime only (NEGEMM / NECast / NEScheduler / Tensor). NEGEMM.cpp, NECast.cpp
# and Tensor.cpp are all compiled into arm_compute_core (src/CMakeLists.txt:879,
# :904, :960). The arm_compute_sve / arm_compute_sve2 / arm_compute_graph
# targets are separate libraries and are NOT built and NOT linked, so no SVE
# machine code enters the binary and non-SVE target machines stay safe.
#
# Why OPENMP=OFF: the SDCShield framework provides one worker thread per core;
# the tests additionally pin the ACL scheduler to 1 thread
# (NEScheduler::get().set_num_threads(1)). Library-internal threading would
# only add nondeterministic scheduling (same philosophy as vendored OpenBLAS
# USE_THREAD=0).
#
# v23.02 has no CMake install rules, so this script hand-assembles the install
# tree: the archive straight from the build dir, plus the header closure
# (arm_compute/ + top-level support/ + include/half for Half.hpp). The tests'
# include closure was probe-verified to compile against exactly this layout
# with a single -I install/include.
#
# Idempotent: skip if install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a already present.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
JOBS=${JOBS:-$(nproc)}
[ -f install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a ] && { ldd --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -oE "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$" > install/.glibc-build-tag 2>/dev/null; echo "install/ already present"; exit 0; }
tar xzf ComputeLibrary-23.02.tar.gz
cmake -S ComputeLibrary-23.02 -B build \
    -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
    -DOPENMP=OFF \
    -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF \
    -DBUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=14
cmake --build build --target arm_compute_core -j"$JOBS"
# hand-assembled install tree (v23.02 ships no install rules)
mkdir -p install/lib install/include
cp build/libarm_compute_core.a install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a
cp -r ComputeLibrary-23.02/arm_compute install/include/
cp -r ComputeLibrary-23.02/support   install/include/
mkdir -p install/include/half
cp -r ComputeLibrary-23.02/include/half/* install/include/half/ 2>/dev/null || true
# provenance: glibc tag, same convention as openssl/openblas build tags
ldd --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -oE "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$" > install/.glibc-build-tag 2>/dev/null || true
echo "OK: $(ls -la install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a)"

content.text: **SIGSEGV @ FAR=0x500 复现了**——与旧注释描述的崩溃特征一致（`RIP=0x518`/FAR 低地址）。import_memory 单独不够。这与 fisttp_arm 不同——差异在哪？fisttp 用 `Scheduler::get()`（NECast 走 CPU backend），而 acl_gemm 用 **NEScheduler**。用 `--on-crash=context -vv` 拿到崩溃回溯，定位帧。

# Task Plan: SDC Test-Case Audit — identify tests that cannot stress their target SDC unit

## Goal
Analyze ALL test cases in SDCShield (tests/common/ + tests/cpu/, both x86-64 reference and ARM64 port) and produce a defect list of tests whose implementation cannot actually stress / detect faults in the SDC unit they claim to cover — i.e., tests that pass trivially, stress the wrong thing, have vacuous golden comparisons, or misreport (pass/skip where they should do real work). Deliver an evidence-backed report (findings.md + audit report doc), one defect per entry with file:line proof.

## Next Step
Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) appended and complete; report at docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md. Fix ordering unchanged: D6 → D11 → D1/D2 → D3(acl) → eigen_svd_cdouble_sve/pocketfft-inverse.

## Current Phase
Complete

## Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) status
Complete (see ### Phase 5 above)

## Phases

### Phase 1: Inventory & Discovery
- [x] Enumerate all test dirs/files from tests/*/meson.build sourcesets (both arches)
- [x] Extract per-test metadata: name, quality_level, minimum_cpu, flags, description (DECLARE_TEST blocks)
- [x] Classify: x86-only / arm-only / common; real vs placeholder-skip vs stub
- [x] Record inventory in findings.md
- **Status:** complete

### Phase 2: Per-test SDC-coverage analysis
For each test: what hardware unit it claims to stress (FMA, SIMD, caches, compression engines, crypto, LSU, ALU...), what it actually computes, whether the golden comparison detects bit errors in that unit.
- [x] Group A: arithmetic/fma/vector/mesh/gather/atomic/arithmetic_arm (ALU/SIMD) — D1/D2 (fma tolerance), D3 (acl_gemm), D4 (tautological consistency), D5 (mesh sum)
- [x] Group B: cache/memory/lock/spinlock/load_port/arm64-mem (memory subsystem) — all have real memcmp/counter checks, OK
- [x] Group C: compression (zlib/zstd/ifs/isa-l) + crypto (openssl/ipsec/crc) — D11 (CRC family hw-vs-hw), compression OK (roundtrip verified)
- [x] Group D: library-math (eigen_*/openblas/sleef/pocketfft) — openblas golden=same lib call (deterministic, acceptable), eigen byte-exact vs first-run, sleef byte-exact vs libm — OK
- [x] Group E: common/special (mce_check, smi_count, ist, misc, jit, virtualization, arm-0102) — D6 (vmx family vacuous pass), D7 (BETA gating), D8 (ist honest skip), D10 (mite checksum)

content.text:
路径清楚了：acl_gemm 无特殊 flag → 走 `run_one_test_children` → fork → 子进程 `child_run` → init+run 都在子进程——**与我成功的 fork repro 同构**！那差异只剩：框架 worker 线程跑 run（repro 是主线程跑）。但 addr2line 说崩在 run 的 `prepare()`，而 init 已完成（configure 成功打印过吗？没有打印……）。**关键疑点：init 里 `data->gemm` 赋值成功与否**。加个诊断：在 run 里 prepare 前判空。但更快的办法——repro 里模拟"**另一个线程先动了 NEScheduler 单例**"：框架所有 worker 线程共享进程，`NEScheduler::get()` 的默认单例在 init 里被 set_num_threads(1) 过，而别的测试/别的线程…… 不对，-e acl_gemm 只跑这一个测试。

再想：**框架 kill 掉 init 线程？** `init_in_aux_thread`！sandstone_run.cpp:1162：`if (init_in_aux_thread)` — init 在**辅助线程**里跑，pthread_join 后返回主线程，然后才 spawn worker 跑 run。ACL 对象在**辅助线程**创建（含 `NEScheduler::get()` 单例首次构造、NEGEMM configure），worker 线程 run。我的 repro 缺这个变量。模拟它。

input.description: Repro 3: init in aux thread, run in worker thread

content.text:
线程模型也正常！三个 repro 全成功、框架内崩——剩余差异只有**编译环境**。框架 acl_gemm.cpp 用 `-march=armv8.1-a+crc+crypto` 编译（ACL 库本身是 `-march=armv8.2-a+fp16` 编的），并 `-O3`、还有个被忽视的嫌犯：**框架覆写 libc rand/random** 与 ACL 无关……不对。等一下——回看崩溃地址特征：`FAR=0x500`、`RIP+0x305bc8` 固定不变、`blr x1` 前是 `ldr x1,[x1,#0x10]`。这其实是 `data->gemm` 本身是**悬垂/垃圾指针**——`test->data` 传给 run 的方式。注意框架里 **run 被调用的线程拿到的 `test->data`** 与 init 设置的是同一个（fork COW 继承）——除非 **`-e` 单测模式的 `--num-threads=1` 下 worker 就是主线程**……

不再猜了。直接在框架内加 printf 诊断（临时）看 `data->gemm` 的值和 init 是否真的完成：

content.text:
**决定性发现**：新 RIP 0x305bb4 解析到 `acl_gemm_run` 里的 **fprintf 本身**（stdio2.h:79 = `__fprintf_chk`）——**`fprintf(stderr, ...)` 崩了**！stderr 是垃圾。这暴露真根因：**框架重定向/关闭了 stderr（或 fd 1/2 被换成非文件）**，ACL 的 Error.cpp 或我们的 fprintf 走 `write(2)`……不对，我们崩在 fprintf——**fd 2 无效**。这是 sandstone 的 crash-context 机制：**子进程崩溃后由父进程收尸时打印的 backtrace 里 RIP 是当时 fprintf 的位置**……

不，更简单的解释统一了所有现象：**init 的 DIAG fprintf 也没打出来**。框架把 **stderr 在 fork 后关掉/重定向到管道**，`fprintf(stderr)` 触发 `FILE*` 锁状态损坏（fork 后 `_IO_lock_t` 死锁或 FILE 结构指向已关闭 fd 的非法写）→ SIGSEGV。而 ACL 的 NEGEMM `prepare()`/`run()` 内部也可能有 fprintf/stderr 使用？不——RIP 在我们自己的 DIAG fprintf 上，说明 run 被调用了、崩在打印上。但 init 的 DIAG 为何也没打？init 在 fork 前的父进程……**输出被吞**是因为 grep 只显示 yaml 的 error 行！

重新抓完整输出，别 grep：

input.command: cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; timeout 60 ./builddir/sdcshield -e acl_gemm -t 5000 -n 1 2>&1 | grep -E "^DIAG" ; echo "--- (上面是 DIAG 原始输出) ---"; timeout 60 ./builddir/sdcshield -e acl_gemm -t 5000 -n 1 2>/dev/null | tail -3

content.text:
**重大线索**：yaml 里**根本没有 acl_gemm 条目**——测试的 init 都没开始（连 logging 都没初始化），crash 发生在**测试启动之前**！结合 RIP 在 acl_gemm_run 的代码段、FAR=0x500——这是 **ELF 静态初始化（C++ 全局构造函数）阶段**或 **forkfd/沙箱**阶段就崩了。`arm_compute::NEGEMM` 的头里有什么静态对象？查 ACL 代码里 `NEScheduler::get()` 的单例——它是 **static local**（函数内静态），首次使用才构造，没问题。但 ACL 里可能有**全局构造函数**的对象（如 kernel registry）——这些在 **fork 后的子进程 exec 前**？不。

真相更简单：**父进程在启动早期（fork 前）就崩了**——某个 ACL 全局构造器在 main 前跑，而框架在 main 前有 **`test_preinit`/`.preinit_array` 或早期 SIGSEGV**。用 `--fork-mode=exec`（exec_each_test 模式，init/run 在全新 exec 的进程里跑）验证：

input.command: cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; echo "=== exec 模式(每次测试重新 exec, 无 fork COW) ==="; timeout 60 ./builddir/sdcshield --fork-mode=exec -e acl_gemm -t 5000 -n 1 2>&1 | grep -E "DIAG|exit:|result" | head -6

content.text:
exec 模式也崩、无 DIAG。这是**确定性**（100% 复现，11/11）。三个 repro 全过、二进制里 ACL 符号正常……回到最基础的差异：**编译标志**。框架用 `-march=armv8.1-a+crc+crypto` 编 `acl_gemm.cpp`，我的 repro 用默认 `-march=armv8-a`。ACL 头里的 **inline NEON 函数**（NEGEMM 调度的 kernel 选择器）在 v8.1 目标下内联出的代码可能与库（v8.2+fp16 编译）不一致？不至于 SIGSEGV。

换最后一个变量隔离：repro 用**框架同款编译标志**重编（-O3 -march=armv8.1-a+crc+crypto -fstack-protector 等）。若崩→编译标志是变量；若过→剩下的就是 sdcshield 的链接布局（--whole-archive 里 ACL 的全局构造器与框架其它静态库的交互）。

input.command: cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield/third-party/acl; g++ -std=c++14 -O3 -march=armv8.1-a+crc+crypto -fstack-clash-protection -fstack-protector-strong -fPIC -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 /tmp/acl_min_repro.cpp -I install/include -L install/lib -l:libarm_compute-core.a -lpthread -ldl -o /tmp/acl_min_repro_f1 2>&1 | head -3; timeout 30 /tmp/acl_min_repro_f1; echo "exit=$?"
input.description: Repro with framework-like compile flags

content.text: **根因抓到了**。`--whole-archive` 强制链入 `OMPScheduler.cpp.o`，它引用 `omp_get_max_threads` 等 OpenMP 符号——但 build.sh 设了 `OPENMP=OFF`，库却仍编了 OMPScheduler（用 **stubs** 编译但符号未解析）。sdcshield 链接时 `-lgomp` 没加,但这些 `omp_*` 未定义符号为何没在 sdcshield 链接时报错？——因为**框架链接顺序里 ACL 在 `--end-group` 前但 `--whole-archive` 包住的是测试库**……回看链接行:`-Wl,--whole-archive -Wl,--start-group ...所有测试库... -Wl,--no-whole-archive ... -l:libarm_compute-core.a -Wl,--end-group`——ACL 在 whole-archive **之外**。所以 OMPScheduler.o 没被拉进来？但**我的 repro 报的错证明 sdcshield 链接应该也报同样错**——除非 sdcshield 链到了别处的 omp 符号。查：

input.command: cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; echo "=== sdcshield 是否实际链入了 OMPScheduler.o / omp 符号谁提供 ==="; nm builddir/sdcshield | grep -E "omp_get_max_threads|OMPScheduler" | head -5; echo; echo "=== acl archive 里 OMPScheduler.o 的 omp 引用是否弱符号/条件 ==="; nm /tmp/aclar/OMPScheduler.cpp.o 2>/dev/null | grep -E "omp_get" | head -5

content.text:
gdb 没拦截住（崩溃在子进程，gdb follow-fork 默认 parent）。注意到新信息：**thread 0 = 主 worker**、runtime 711ms、utime 11s+stime 22s —— **CPU 时间 34s 但 wall 只有 0.7s**？！这说明**多线程在疯狂跑**。加上 `-n 1` 却有 thread 0/1……更关键：**mce_check 前面跑过**（test 顺序），且这是 `utime/stime 巨大 + minflt 223`——像是**内存分配风暴**。

等等——回看第一次成功诊断的机会：`utime: 11.397, stime: 22.794` 而运行只 0.7 秒——这是**三线程满载**。但 `-n 1`！这不对。除非…… **NEGEMM 的 kernel 在 CPU 检测时 fallback 到了某个 pathological 路径**。

不再猜测。用 `set follow-fork-mode child` 让 gdb 进子进程抓真栈：

input.command: cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; timeout 150 gdb -batch -ex "set follow-fork-mode child" -ex "set detach-on-fork off" -ex "run -e acl_gemm -t 5000 -n 1" -ex "bt 20" --args ./builddir/sdcshield 2>&1 | grep -E "^#|signal|Program received" | head -25
input.description: gdb follow child to catch real crash stack

# Task Plan: SDC Test-Case Audit — identify tests that cannot stress their target SDC unit

## Goal
Analyze ALL test cases in SDCShield (tests/common/ + tests/cpu/, both x86-64 reference and ARM64 port) and produce a defect list of tests whose implementation cannot actually stress / detect faults in the SDC unit they claim to cover — i.e., tests that pass trivially, stress the wrong thing, have vacuous golden comparisons, or misreport (pass/skip where they should do real work). Deliver an evidence-backed report (findings.md + audit report doc), one defect per entry with file:line proof.

## Next Step
Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) appended and complete; report at docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md. Fix ordering unchanged: D6 → D11 → D1/D2 → D3(acl) → eigen_svd_cdouble_sve/pocketfft-inverse.

## Current Phase
Complete

## Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) status
Complete (see ### Phase 5 above)

## Phases

### Phase 1: Inventory & Discovery
- [x] Enumerate all test dirs/files from tests/*/meson.build sourcesets (both arches)
- [x] Extract per-test metadata: name, quality_level, minimum_cpu, flags, description (DECLARE_TEST blocks)
- [x] Classify: x86-only / arm-only / common; real vs placeholder-skip vs stub
- [x] Record inventory in findings.md
- **Status:** complete

### Phase 2: Per-test SDC-coverage analysis
For each test: what hardware unit it claims to stress (FMA, SIMD, caches, compression engines, crypto, LSU, ALU...), what it actually computes, whether the golden comparison detects bit errors in that unit.

- [x] Group E: common/special (mce_check, smi_count, ist, misc, jit, virtualization, arm-0102) — D6 (vmx family vacuous pass), D7 (BETA gating), D8 (ist honest skip), D10 (mite checksum)

**真栈抓到了**：

```
#0 fprintf (DIAG run...) — acl_gemm_run:112
#1 acl_gemm_run cpu=0
#2 thread_runner (sandstone_run.cpp:778)   ← worker 线程
```

**run 确实被调用了**（cpu=0，thread 0），崩在**我加的 DIAG fprintf 上**——`_IO_2_1_stderr_` 的 FILE 锁被 fork 损坏（stderr 是 libc 全局，子进程继承的锁状态本应完好……）。**x1=0、x20=0**：`data->gemm` 为 **NULL**！看：fprintf 参数里 `data` 和 `gemm` 都会求值——**`data->gemm` 解引用 NULL `data`** → FAR=0x500 ≈ `data=NULL + offset 0x518(gemm 字段)` + vtable load 偏移。

**根因确认：`test->data` 在 run 里是 NULL** —— init 里 `test->data = d` 的赋值**没有传递到 run 的 test 指针**。为什么 repro 正常而框架 NULL？因为**框架的 `test` 结构体是复制进子进程的**（fork COW 继承了 `test->data`）……除非——**`init_in_aux_thread`**！init 在**辅助线程**跑（sandstone_run.cpp:1162-1175），它对 `test->data` 的写入发生在**子进程内**，没问题。但是！注意 thread_runner:778 是 **worker 线程入口**直接调 `test->test_run(test, cpu)`——**worker 线程拿到的 test 是同一个**。除非 **init 还没跑完 run 就开始**？不可能，串行的。

等等——`data=NULL` 的另一个来源：**`test->data` 在 init 里被 `sandbox` 或什么清掉了**。或者——**acl_gemm 的 init 根本没跑**！回看 exec 模式：exec 后的全新进程里跑 init+run，也崩。若 init 没跑，`test->data` 是静态初始化的 NULL！**为什么 init 不跑？** 因为 `run_one_test_children` fork 后 child_run 里 `prepare_test_common(test)` → 然后才 test_init——除非 **init 之前就 crash**。但栈里明明在 run……

**再看一遍栈**：`#1 acl_gemm_run (test=<optimized out>, cpu=0)`。`test` 被优化掉了——`data` 从寄存器/栈来。x20=0（通常存 `data`）。**`test->data` 是 NULL 或垃圾**。此时最直接的解释：**init 对 `test->data` 的赋值写到了子进程 A，run 在子进程 B**（fracture 的多 slice！`slices_for_test` → child_count>1 → 多个子进程，每个 fork 自**父进程**——init 在第一个子进程跑的，后续子进程从父 fork，父的 test->data 从未被赋值 = NULL！

**fracture_loop_count=4** 的 acl_gemm → `current_max_loop_count=4` → 循环 4 圈每圈 fork 新子进程（1769-1775 行 "do we fracture?"）→ 但那是同一子进程内循环……

不绕了。直接验证“多子进程”假设：`-e` + `-n 1` 下 slices=1，child=1。看 `thread_runner:778` 之前 worker 线程 spawn 时机 vs test_init 完成时机——`sandstone_run.cpp:1143` run_one_test_inner 里 init（1161-1178）→ 之后才 spawn workers。**除非 `-t 5000` + fracture 把 run_one_test_inner 再入**……

**决定性测试**：把 DIAG 移到 init 第一行，重跑看 init 到底跑没跑：

p='tests/cpu/arithmetic_arm/acl_gemm.cpp'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''static int acl_gemm_init(struct test *test)
{
    acl_gemm_data *data = new acl_gemm_data;''','''static int acl_gemm_init(struct test *test)
{
    fprintf(stderr, "DIAG init entered\\n");
    acl_gemm_data *data = new acl_gemm_data;''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("ok")
EOF
ninja -C builddir 2>&1 | tail -1; timeout 60 ./builddir/sdcshield -e acl_gemm -t 5000 -n 1 2>&1 | grep -cE "^DIAG init" | xargs echo "DIAG init 行数:"; timeout 60 ./builddir/sdcshield -e acl_gemm -t 5000 -n 1 2>&1 | grep -E "DIAG|signal 11" | head -5

content.text:
**找到了**！`thread_runner` 里：`protect_shmem()`（就在下方）—— `mprotect(sApp->shmem, PROT_READ)` 把**共享内存设为只读**。如果 `test->data` 或 acl_gemm 的对象分配在……不对，`new` 在堆。但**`test` 结构体本身**！`DECLARE_TEST` 的 `struct test` 是**全局静态**（.data 段），而 init 写 `test->data = d` —— 若 test 结构在 **shmem（只读保护后）**……不，`struct test _test_acl_gemm` 在普通 .data。

**但是**！`current_test()` 和 `sApp->shmem`——CLAUDE.md：测试迭代间 fork 的子进程会 re-exec？回看 run_one_test_children 的 exec 分支（1390-1405）：**`fork-mode=exec` 时 execv 重启**。而**默认 fork 模式**下 fracture 循环在子进程内。

**等等，我漏了最关键的**——回看 `child_run` 调用点（1478-1481）：`child_run(const_cast<struct test *>(test), i)`。而 `test` 指针来自**父进程的 tests 数组**。fork COW 下子进程的 `test->data = d` 写入只在子进程。**fracture 的重入**（1776-1800）不会重新 fork。

好，我不再逆推代码。**用最硬的证据**：把 DIAG 直接打进 `test_run_wrapper_function`（框架层），打印它收到的 `test->id` 和 `test->data`。若 data 为 NULL → init 真没在**这个进程**里跑 → 说明 fork 时序与我理解的不同：

content.text:
**决定性线索**：`child_run` (1232-1245) 第 1235 行——**`protect_shmem()` 在 `run_one_test_inner` 之前**调用，把 shmem 只读保护。而 **`restrict_topology`**（1238）……

不对，继续锁定。**`init_in_aux_thread=true`**（1244 传的）——init 在辅助线程跑。回看 1162-1175：init_thread_runner 里 **`pin_to_logical_processor(LogicalProcessor(device_info[0].cpu_number))`**。辅助线程被**钉在 CPU 0**跑 init！而 ACL 的 init 里调用了 `NEScheduler::get().set_num_threads(1)` + `NEGEMM::configure`。

**但真正可疑的是**：我的 fork/thread repro 都成功，唯独框架必崩，且 **`data=NULL`**。`data` 是 `new` 的堆指针，init 里 `test->data = d` 写入的是 **`struct test`**——一个 **`tests` ELF section 里的全局静态对象**。fork 后子进程改它没问题（COW）。

……**除非 `-e acl_gemm` 选择的不止一个 test**！`-e` 是正则匹配！**`acl_gemm` 也许同时匹配了 `fisttp_arm`? 不。但 `mce_check` 永远附加**！mce_check 无碍。**多个匹配**：`-e acl_gemm` 只匹配 acl_gemm。

好——祭出终极致手段：**printf 大法进框架**（test_run_wrapper_function 打印 test->id 和 test->data）：

**连 WRAP 都没打印**！崩溃点 RIP 又变了（+0x305c44），且发生在 **wrapper 之前**。这说明崩溃根本不在 test_run 的调用链里——**是 `struct test` 静态对象本身的问题**：`strcmp(test->id, ...)` 都没执行到。RIP 在 acl_gemm.cpp 的代码里（305c44 附近都是 acl_gemm_run 的地址区间）……**`test->test_run` 调用即崩**？不——WRAP printf 在调用前。

**灵光一现**：`RIP = sdcshield+0x305c44`，每次加代码 RIP 都变（305bc8→305bb4→305c44）——**RIP 一直跟踪 acl_gemm_run 函数的入口附近**！这就是**静态链函数指针/重定位**问题。而且 FAR=0x500 **恒定不变**。`0x500` = **1280** ——这是 `struct test` 里某个字段的**固定偏移**！`test` 指针 = **NULL**，`test+offset(0x500)` 处 load！

**真相**：`test_run_wrapper_function` 收到的 `test` 是 NULL？不——WRAP 没打印是因为 strcmp 没匹配？若 `test->id` 是垃圾，strcmp 崩……但崩点在 acl_gemm_run 里。

**全部现象唯一自洽的解释**：**`current_test()` 返回 NULL 或垃圾**，`test->test_run(test)` = load from [NULL+0x518]（test_run 字段偏移）→ 值恰好是 acl_gemm_run 的地址 → 调用进入 acl_gemm_run，参数 test=垃圾/NULL → 第一行 `CAST(test->data)` load [NULL+0x500]（data 字段偏移）→ **FAR=0x500**！

**验证**：`struct test` 里 `data` 字段偏移是否 = **0x500**，`test_run` 字段偏移是否 = **0x518**：

**结构体偏移推翻了 NULL-test 假设**：`data` 在 offset 136 (0x88)，`test_run` 在 64 (0x40)——FAR=0x500 对不上 NULL+0x88。所以 **`test` 不是 NULL，是 `data` 指针指向的对象里 offset 0x500 处 load 崩**。`acl_gemm_data` 结构体很大（3×16KB 数组 + Tensor 对象 + NEGEMM*），`gemm` 字段在 **offset 0x500** 附近！看 acl_gemm_data 布局：a(Tensor) + b + d + golden + gemm + 3×16KB bufs。Tensor 对象很大。`data->gemm` load = `[data + gemm_offset]`。若 `data` 本身损坏（指向 freed/野指针），FAR=0x500 = data 基址+0x500 恰是 gemm 字段。**data 指针损坏**——init 里 `new acl_gemm_data` 的堆地址在 run 时已失效。什么会动堆？**`test->data` 被谁覆盖**……

**等等！** 想起 `run_one_test_inner` 1150-1152: `test->per_thread = sApp->user_thread_data.data()` + `std::fill_n`——**每次 run 前 per_thread 重设**。无害。

**最后一击——回看崩溃 trace #3**：`operator() (__closure=0x0, ptr=0xffffffffe390)` —— **`ptr=0xffffffffe390`**！这不是合法堆地址！`__closure=0x0`！**sandstone_thread.cpp:117 的线程入口闭包收到 ptr=0xffffffffe390**（负数/被截断的值）——**线程创建传参就错了**。看 sandstone_thread.cpp:110-120：

`ptr=0xffffffffe390` 是 gdb 对损坏栈的解释（那段 closure 帧本身是重构的），不是实锤。我花了很长时间还没收敛。**做减法收敛**：我有一个 100% 成功的 repro、一个 100% 崩的框架环境。把 **repro 编进框架同款构建**——把 acl_gemm 的 init/run 改成**最简形式**（不做任何 ACL 调用，只 `test->data` 存 int），若还崩→框架问题与本 test 无关；若不崩→逐步加回 ACL 调用二分。这是最机械但必然收敛的方法。

先撤掉 DIAG 和 WRAP 修改，然后做最小化二分：

cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; git diff --stat; echo "---"; git checkout framework/sandstone_run.cpp && python3 - <<'EOF'
# 撤掉 acl_gemm.cpp 里的 DIAG fprintf(3 处)
p='tests/cpu/arithmetic_arm/acl_gemm.cpp'
s=open(p).read()
import re
s=s.replace('    fprintf(stderr, "DIAG init entered\\n");\n','')
s=s.replace('    fprintf(stderr, "DIAG init done: data=%p gemm=%p\\n", (void*)data, (void*)data->gemm);\n','')
s=s.replace('    fprintf(stderr, "DIAG run cpu=%d: data=%p gemm=%p\\n", cpu, (void*)data, (void*)data->gemm);\n','')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("DIAG removed:", "DIAG" not in s)
EOF

23	# links them statically to avoid a runtime GLIBC_2.38 dependency). The 3 AOR
24	# tests (aor_math.cpp, aor_string.cpp, cbw_arm.cpp) are therefore excluded
25	# below — they are listed as comments and not built, so there is no link error.

content.text: `git checkout meson.build` 把 **bisect-4 注释版**恢复了——它还引用已删除的 `acl_incdir`……不对，checkout 恢复的是 **git HEAD 版**（旧的 host-lib 版本，含 `acl_incdir_opt`）。我的 vendored 版改动被 checkout 撤销了！重新应用 meson 改写（这次含正确内容）：

input.old_string:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Arm Compute Library: libarm_compute.so lives in /usr/lib64 (default linker
# search path); the C++ tensor/operator headers ship only under a third-party
# tree on the build host. Configured via -Denable_acl=auto|enabled|disabled and
# -Dacl_incdir=/path (the header tree; empty = system default).
# On 22.03/20.03 the ACL runtime is built against a newer libstdc++ (GLIBCXX_3.4.29+)
# and won't link in the older toolchain; pass -Denable_acl=disabled there (the
# container-build.sh driver does this via -D, no source sed needed).
# When disabled (or auto + not found), acl_sources is empty and acl_dep is a
# no-op declare_dependency(), so acl_tests_lib is an empty static lib that pulls
# no ACL symbols — the 2 ACL tests simply aren't built.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
acl_enable = get_option('enable_acl')
acl_incdir_opt = get_option('acl_incdir')
acl_lib = cc.find_library('arm_compute', dirs : ['/usr/lib64'], required : (acl_enable == 'enabled'))

# auto: found iff the library is present AND headers are reachable (either a
# user-specified -Dacl_incdir, or arm_compute/ in the system include path).
acl_found = acl_lib.found()
if acl_found and acl_incdir_opt == ''
  acl_found = cc.has_header('arm_compute/arm.h', required : false)
endif

acl_incdir = acl_incdir_opt != '' ? acl_incdir_opt : '/usr/include'
acl_sources = []
acl_dep = declare_dependency()
if acl_enable != 'disabled' and acl_found
  acl_dep = declare_dependency(
      compile_args : acl_incdir_opt != '' ? ['-isystem', acl_incdir] : [],
      link_args    : ['-L/usr/lib64', '-larm_compute'],
  )
  acl_sources = files(
      'acl_gemm.cpp',
      'fisttp_arm.cpp',
  )
endif
input.new_string:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Arm Compute Library: VENDORED source build (third-party/acl, Arm Compute
# Library v23.02 built by its build.sh — first official pure-CMake release;
# requires gcc >= 10.2 which 24.03 (12.3), 22.03 (10.3) and 20.03
# (gcc-toolset-10 via supplement-20.03-gcc10.sh) all satisfy). This replaces
# the old scheme of linking the host's /usr/lib64/libarm_compute.so against a
# separate header tree via -Dacl_incdir, which was ABI-broken on 22.03/20.03
# (v20.02 runtime vs v22.11 headers, GLIBCXX mismatch) and disabled there.
# The vendored build produces ONLY the arm_compute_core target (NEON runtime:
# NEGEMM/NECast/Tensor — src/CMakeLists.txt:879/904/960); the sve/sve2/graph
# targets are neither built nor linked, so no SVE machine code enters the
# binary and non-SVE target machines stay safe.
# Probe pattern identical to openssl/openblas/sleef: prefer
# third-party/acl/install (built by build.sh); when absent under enable_acl=auto
# the 2 ACL tests are simply not built (acl_sources empty, acl_dep a no-op
# declare_dependency()); enable_acl=enabled makes a missing install/ a hard
# error instead of a silent degrade.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
acl_enable = get_option('enable_acl')
acl_install = meson.current_source_dir() / '../../../third-party/acl/install'
acl_sources = []
acl_dep = declare_dependency()
if acl_enable != 'disabled'
  if run_command('test', '-f', acl_install / 'lib' / 'libarm_compute-core.a', check : false).returncode() == 0
    acl_dep = declare_dependency(
        include_directories : include_directories('../../../third-party/acl/install/include', is_system : true),
        link_args : ['-L' + acl_install / 'lib', '-l:libarm_compute-core.a'],
    )
    message('Using vendored ACL (third-party/acl/install)')
    acl_sources = files(
        'acl_gemm.cpp',
        'fisttp_arm.cpp',
    )
  elif acl_enable == 'enabled'
    error('enable_acl=enabled but third-party/acl/install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a not found — run third-party/acl/build.sh first')
  else
    message('ACL install/ not found under third-party/acl — run its build.sh to enable the 2 ACL tests.')
  endif
endif

input.command:
cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='tests/cpu/arithmetic_arm/meson.build'
s=open(p).read()
old_block_start = s.index('# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Arm Compute Library:')
old_block_end = s.index('# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# compiler-rt builtins:')
new_block = '''# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Arm Compute Library: VENDORED source build (third-party/acl, Arm Compute
# Library v23.02 built by its build.sh — first official pure-CMake release;
# requires gcc >= 10.2 which 24.03 (12.3), 22.03 (10.3) and 20.03
# (gcc-toolset-10 via supplement-20.03-gcc10.sh) all satisfy). This replaces
# the old scheme of linking the host's /usr/lib64/libarm_compute.so against a
# separate header tree via -Dacl_incdir, which was ABI-broken on 22.03/20.03
# (v20.02 runtime vs v22.11 headers, GLIBCXX mismatch) and disabled there.
# The vendored build produces ONLY the arm_compute_core target (NEON runtime:
# NEGEMM/NECast/Tensor — src/CMakeLists.txt:879/904/960); the sve/sve2/graph
# targets are neither built nor linked, so no SVE machine code enters the
# binary and non-SVE target machines stay safe.
# Probe pattern identical to openssl/openblas/sleef: prefer
# third-party/acl/install (built by build.sh); when absent under enable_acl=auto
# the 2 ACL tests are simply not built (acl_sources empty, acl_dep a no-op
# declare_dependency()); enable_acl=enabled makes a missing install/ a hard
# error instead of a silent degrade.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
acl_enable = get_option('enable_acl')
acl_install = meson.current_source_dir() / '../../../third-party/acl/install'
acl_sources = []
acl_dep = declare_dependency()
if acl_enable != 'disabled'
  if run_command('test', '-f', acl_install / 'lib' / 'libarm_compute-core.a', check : false).returncode() == 0
    acl_dep = declare_dependency(
        include_directories : include_directories('../../../third-party/acl/install/include', is_system : true),
        link_args : ['-L' + acl_install / 'lib', '-l:libarm_compute-core.a'],
    )
    message('Using vendored ACL (third-party/acl/install)')
    acl_sources = files(
        'acl_gemm.cpp',
        'fisttp_arm.cpp',
    )
  elif acl_enable == 'enabled'
    error('enable_acl=enabled but third-party/acl/install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a not found — run third-party/acl/build.sh first')
  else
    message('ACL install/ not found under third-party/acl — run its build.sh to enable the 2 ACL tests.')
  endif
endif

'''
# 头部过时注释(13-16行)也一并修
s = s.replace('''#   * Arm Compute Library ... libarm_compute.so at /usr/lib64; headers under the
#                             third-party arm-opt-install tree (no /usr/include/arm_compute).''','''#   * Arm Compute Library ... vendored source build, third-party/acl (v23.02,
#                             build.sh → install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a); no
#                             host libarm_compute.so is used or required.''')
s = s[:old_block_start] + new_block + s[old_block_end:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("meson re-applied, acl_incdir refs:", s.count('acl_incdir'))
PYEOF

cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; git checkout tests/cpu/arithmetic_arm/meson.build && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='tests/cpu/arithmetic_arm/meson.build'
lines = open(p).readlines()
s = ''.join(lines)
# 精确定位: 旧 ACL 块 = 从 "# Arm Compute Library: libarm_compute.so" 的分隔行 到 "# compiler-rt builtins" 的分隔行
import re
m_start = None; m_end = None
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if 'Arm Compute Library: libarm_compute.so lives in /usr/lib64' in l and m_start is None:
        m_start = i-1  # 其上的 ---- 分隔行
    if 'compiler-rt builtins: static soft-float integer implementation' in l and m_end is None:
        m_end = i-1    # 其上的 ---- 分隔行
assert m_start is not None and m_end is not None and m_end > m_start, (m_start, m_end)
print(f"旧 ACL 块: 行 {m_start+1}..{m_end+1}")
new_block = '''# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Arm Compute Library: VENDORED source build (third-party/acl, Arm Compute
# Library v23.02 built by its build.sh — first official pure-CMake release;
# requires gcc >= 10.2 which 24.03 (12.3), 22.03 (10.3) and 20.03
# (gcc-toolset-10 via supplement-20.03-gcc10.sh) all satisfy). This replaces
# the old scheme of linking the host's /usr/lib64/libarm_compute.so against a
# separate header tree via -Dacl_incdir, which was ABI-broken on 22.03/20.03
# (v20.02 runtime vs v22.11 headers, GLIBCXX mismatch) and disabled there.
# The vendored build produces ONLY the arm_compute_core target (NEON runtime:
# NEGEMM/NECast/Tensor — src/CMakeLists.txt:879/904/960); the sve/sve2/graph
# targets are neither built nor linked, so no SVE machine code enters the
# binary and non-SVE target machines stay safe.
# Probe pattern identical to openssl/openblas/sleef: prefer
# third-party/acl/install (built by build.sh); when absent under enable_acl=auto
# the 2 ACL tests are simply not built (acl_sources empty, acl_dep a no-op
# declare_dependency()); enable_acl=enabled makes a missing install/ a hard
# error instead of a silent degrade.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
acl_enable = get_option('enable_acl')
acl_install = meson.current_source_dir() / '../../../third-party/acl/install'
acl_sources = []
acl_dep = declare_dependency()
if acl_enable != 'disabled'
  if run_command('test', '-f', acl_install / 'lib' / 'libarm_compute-core.a', check : false).returncode() == 0
    acl_dep = declare_dependency(
        include_directories : include_directories('../../../third-party/acl/install/include', is_system : true),
        link_args : ['-L' + acl_install / 'lib', '-l:libarm_compute-core.a'],
    )
    message('Using vendored ACL (third-party/acl/install)')
    acl_sources = files(
        'acl_gemm.cpp',
        'fisttp_arm.cpp',
    )
  elif acl_enable == 'enabled'
    error('enable_acl=enabled but third-party/acl/install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a not found — run third-party/acl/build.sh first')
  else
    message('ACL install/ not found under third-party/acl — run its build.sh to enable the 2 ACL tests.')
  endif
endif

'''
out = ''.join(lines[:m_start]) + new_block + ''.join(lines[m_end:])

s=open(p).read()

             * long-double reference; the healthy rounding gap was measured at
             * ~1e-6 absolute on |golden|~0.1 (about 8 float ulp, i.e. ~1e-5
             * relative), right at the theoretical worst case K*eps ~ 7.6e-6.
             * Use 1e-4 relative with a 1e-3 absolute floor: ~13x headroom over
             * the measured gap (no false positives on healthy silicon) while a
             * real SDC — a flipped FMA operand bit, a wrong kernel constant —
             * produces O(1)-magnitude errors, 3+ orders of magnitude above it.
             * The old 1e-3f ABSOLUTE floor masked ~5 orders of single-bit
             * errors on small outputs; this replaces it. */
            float tol = 1e-4f * fmaxf(1e-3f, fabsf(data->golden[i]));
            if (diff > tol) {'''
new='''            /* Tolerance calibration (measured, two rounds): the ACL NEON kernel
             * accumulates K=64 float products in its own tiling order while the
             * golden is a long-double reference. A pure relative tolerance is
             * wrong for this workload: near-cancellation outputs (|golden| as
             * small as ~9e-4 from |a|,|b| <= 1 operands) carry an absolute
             * rounding gap of ~4e-7 — a ~4e-4 RELATIVE gap that no sane
             * relative tolerance can absorb. The correct bound is absolute and
             * scales with the operand magnitude, not the output: K*eps*max|a*b|
             * = 64 * 1.2e-7 * 1 ~ 7.7e-6. Use 1e-4f absolute: ~13x headroom
             * over that worst case (no false positives on healthy silicon,
             * verified) while a real SDC — flipped FMA operand bit, wrong
             * kernel constant — produces O(1)-magnitude errors, 4 orders above
             * it. Still 10x tighter than the old 1e-3f absolute floor, which
             * additionally had no cancellation story at all. */
            float tol = 1e-4f;
            if (diff > tol) {'''
assert old in s

open(p,'w').write(s)
print("absolute tolerance applied")

cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; git add third-party/acl/ComputeLibrary-23.02.tar.gz third-party/acl/build.sh third-party/acl/.gitignore meson_options.txt && git commit -m "vendor(acl): source-level Arm Compute Library v23.02 build

Replace the host-binary ACL scheme (system libarm_compute.so at
/usr/lib64 + separate -Dacl_incdir header tree, ABI-broken on
22.03/20.03 and disabled there) with a vendored source build, same
pattern as openssl/openblas/sleef:

- third-party/acl/ComputeLibrary-23.02.tar.gz: upstream source
  (first official pure-CMake release; gcc >= 10.2 which 24.03 (12.3),
  22.03 (10.3) and 20.03 (gcc-toolset-10) all satisfy — single version
  covers all three OSes, no per-OS matrix needed)
- third-party/acl/build.sh: CMake build of ONLY the arm_compute_core
  target (NEON runtime: NEGEMM/NECast/Tensor, src/CMakeLists.txt
  :879/904/960); sve/sve2/graph targets are neither built nor linked so
  no SVE machine code enters the binary. OPENMP=OFF (framework provides
  its own per-core threads, same philosophy as OpenBLAS USE_THREAD=0).
  POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON (sdcshield links -pie). v23.02 ships no
  CMake install rules, so the install tree (archive + arm_compute/ +
  support/ + half/ header closure) is hand-assembled; the header closure
  was probe-verified to compile with a single -I. Idempotent like the
  other vendored build scripts, glibc-build-tag included.
- meson probe identical to the other vendored libs: prefer
  third-party/acl/install; enable_acl=auto degrades with a message when
  absent, enable_acl=enabled is a hard error. The acl_incdir option is
  gone (host header trees are no longer a thing).

Verified on openEuler 24.03 SP4 aarch64 (Kunpeng 920):
- bash third-party/acl/build.sh -> install/lib/libarm_compute-core.a
  (18.4 MB), 118 NEGEMM/NECast symbols present in the archive
- meson setup: 'Using vendored ACL (third-party/acl/install)'
- ninja: 338/338 clean link, no new warnings
- --list-tests lists acl_gemm + fisttp_arm; NEGEMM symbols in the
  binary; ldd shows no system libarm_compute dependency"

cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; git add tests/cpu/arithmetic_arm/acl_gemm.cpp tests/cpu/arithmetic_arm/meson.build && git commit -m "fix(acl_gemm): root-cause the historical SIGSEGV — missing test->data assignment — and run NEGEMM for real

The acl_gemm test has been dead code since it was written: unconditional
return EXIT_SKIP in both init and run, with a comment attributing the
skip to 'ACL NEGEMM crashes (SIGSEGV @0x518) under sandstone's
fork-per-iteration model'. That attribution was wrong. Root-caused today
by bisection (POD struct / no-ACL-calls / no-headers / no-archive builds
all crashed identically) plus a coredump backtrace:

- the real bug: acl_gemm_init NEVER assigned test->data (fisttp_arm.cpp:114
  has it; this file never did), so test_run/test_cleanup dereferenced a
  garbage pointer — struct acl_gemm_data is ~48KB, its gemm field sits
  around offset 0x500, exactly matching the constant FAR=0x500 of every
  crash. Fork-safety was never the issue: a standalone repro of the very
  same NEGEMM+import_memory pattern (plain, forked, and aux-thread) runs
  cleanly.
- fork-safety hardening kept anyway: the three tensors now borrow
  per-thread alignas(128) buffers via allocator()->import_memory() (the
  pattern fisttp_arm already uses) instead of allocator()->allocate(),
  so ACL owns no heap that would need to survive a fork.
- golden: naive triple loop now accumulates in long double — an
  INDEPENDENT high-precision reference for the NEON kernel result.
- tolerance: the old 1e-3f absolute floor is replaced by 1e-4f absolute,
  calibrated in two measured rounds: healthy |diff| reaches ~1e-6 on
  |golden|~0.1 (8 float ulp) and ~4e-7 on near-cancellation outputs
  (|golden|~9e-4) — i.e. a ~4e-4 RELATIVE gap that no relative tolerance
  can absorb. The correct bound is K*eps*max|a*b| = 64*1.2e-7 ~ 7.7e-6;
  1e-4f gives ~13x headroom over that worst case (zero false positives
  across 5s single-thread and 8-thread runs) while remaining 10x tighter
  than the old floor, and a real SDC (flipped FMA operand, wrong kernel
  constant) lands 4 orders of magnitude above it.

Verified on openEuler 24.03 SP4 aarch64 (Kunpeng 920):
- ./builddir/sdcshield -e acl_gemm -t 5000 -n 1  -> exit: pass (first
  real NEGEMM run in this test's history)
- ./builddir/sdcshield -e acl_gemm -t 5000 -n 8  -> exit: pass
- ./builddir/sdcshield -e fisttp_arm -t 5000 -n 1 -> exit: pass
- ./builddir/sdcshield -e zstd19 -t 3000 -n 1     -> exit: pass
- ./builddir/sdcshield -e gmp_bignum -t 3000 -n 1 -> exit: pass

x86-64 non-regression: arithmetic_arm is aarch64-only (guard in
tests/cpu/meson.build); x86 builds never compile this file."

## Session 2026-09-19: Task 1+2 完成 (历史性突破)

**acl_gemm 历史 SIGSEGV 从来不是 "fork-per-iteration" 问题** — 真因是 init 里**从未给 test->data 赋值**(fisttp_arm.cpp:114 有,该文件没有),run/cleanup 解引用垃圾指针。struct acl_gemm_data ~48KB, gemm 字段恰在 offset ~0x500 = 崩溃常量 FAR=0x500。二分证据链: POD struct/无ACL调用/无ACL头/不链archive 全部同样崩溃 + coredump backtrace (thread_runner→acl_gemm_run, data=垃圾)。独立 repro(plain/fork/aux-thread 三种)全部正常跑通 NEGEMM。

1. 1e-5 相对: 健康差 ~1e-6 abs on |g|~0.1 (8 ulp) → 贴边 fail

ACL_HDR="/home/sdc/root/arm64-sdc-fuzzing/third_party/arm-opt-install/include"
ACL_LIB="/usr/lib64"
CLANG_RT="/usr/lib/clang/17"
# ACL 头/incdir 仅 24.03 系列(容器镜像==host 同 SP,路径有效);22.03/20.03 传
# -Denable_acl=disabled(inner 脚本),不需要 ACL 头 — 挂载反而引入多系列并行时
# 对同一 host 目录的并发 :Z relabel 竞态。
if [ "$SERIES" = "24.03" ] && [ -d "$ACL_HDR" ]; then
    EXTRA_MESON+=("-Dacl_incdir=$ACL_HDR")
fi
EXTRA_MESON_STR="${EXTRA_MESON[*]:-}"
# :Z 让 podman 给挂载点打 SELinux 私有标签(容器可 exec 挂载的脚本/二进制),
# 否则 SELinux enforcing 系统会 "Permission denied"(与 verify-built-pristine.sh 一致)。
MOUNTS=(-v "$SDCSRC_ROOT:/src:ro,Z" -v "$RPMDIR_HOST:/rpms:ro,Z" -v "$OUTDIR_HOST:/out:Z" -v "$INNER_HOST:$INNER:ro,Z")
# 20.03 用 meson 源码包 (RPM 版的 meson 0.59 跑不动于 python3.7)。
# 源码包入仓 third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4(11M, 纯源码, 可复现)。
[ "$SERIES" = "20.03" ] && [ -d "$SDCSRC_ROOT/third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4" ] && \
    MOUNTS+=(-v "$SDCSRC_ROOT/third-party/meson/meson-0.59.4:/meson-src:ro")
if [ "$SERIES" = "24.03" ] && [ -d "$ACL_HDR" ]; then
    MOUNTS+=(-v "$ACL_HDR:$ACL_HDR:ro,Z")
    [ -d "$ACL_LIB" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute.so:$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute.so:ro" -v "$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute_graph.so:$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute_graph.so:ro")
    [ -d "$CLANG_RT" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$CLANG_RT:$CLANG_RT:ro")
fi

timeout 1200 podman run --rm --user=0 \
    "${MOUNTS[@]}" \
    -e OPENEULER_MACRO="$OEU_MACRO" \
    -e CPPSTD="$CPPSTD" \
    -e EXTRA_MESON_ARGS="$EXTRA_MESON_STR" \
    -e MESON_BIN="$MESON_BIN" \
    "$IMG" \
    bash "$INNER"

echo "==> 产物在: $OUTDIR_HOST"
ls -la "$OUTDIR_HOST"

content.text:
github release 下载超时（大文件）。改用**已有先例的模式**：22.03/20.03 的 cmake 走 **repo RPM**（依赖链已确认轻）——`supplement` 脚本机制照搬 `supplement-20.03-gcc10.sh`，下载 cmake-data/filesystem/rpm-macros 主包到 rpms 子模块目录。但 rpms 子模块未 init（目录空）——本机当前没有可用的镜像/RPM 树环境，我无法**实跑容器验证**。

**基于诚实原则的方案落地**：Task 3 的可交付内容改为——(a) inner/outer 脚本的 ACL 原生重建逻辑（完整、模式对齐 sleef）；(b) `supplement-cmake.sh` 新脚本（供有 RPM 树的环境执行）；(c) `bash -n` + host 构建非回归作为**本机可完成的验证**，容器实跑留待有 podman 的环境（脚本注释明确说明）。开始改：

input.command:
cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='scripts/offline-build/container-build.sh'
s=open(p).read()

# ---- 改动 1: inner 脚本里 ACL_OPT 段替换为容器内 ACL 原生重建 ----
old_acl_inner = '''# ACL (Arm Compute Library) 收敛:用 meson option -Denable_acl 替代 sed 改源码。
# 22.03/20.03 的 ACL 原生库是 v20.02 (GCC10 libstdc++), 与 host 头 (v22.11,
# GCC12) ABI 不兼容, fisttp_arm 链接失败 (undefined GLIBCXX_3.4.29/3.4.30)。
# 故 22.03/20.03 传 -Denable_acl=disabled (meson.build 里 acl_sources=[] 空库,
# 不链 -larm_compute, 跳过 2 ACL 测试)。24.03 不传 = auto (host 有 ACL 则构建)。
ACL_OPT=""
if [ -n "${OPENEULER_MACRO:-}" ]; then
    ACL_OPT="-Denable_acl=disabled"
    echo "  ACL: -Denable_acl=disabled (22.03/20.03 跳过 2 ACL 测试)"
fi
'''
new_acl_inner = '''# ACL (Arm Compute Library): vendored 源码构建(third-party/acl, v23.02),
# 与 openssl/openblas/sleef 同一模式: install/ 的 glibc-build-tag 与本容器
# 不同则容器内原生重建(ACL CMakeLists 要求 gcc>=10.2: 24.03 系统 gcc 12.3,
# 22.03 系统 gcc 10.3, 20.03 用已激活的 gcc-toolset-10, 三者均满足)。
# ACL 需要 cmake>=3.13: 24.03 镜像自带;22.03/20.03 镜像无 cmake 时尝试
# /rpms 树里的 cmake RPM(supplement-cmake.sh 预下);仍无则删除宿主 install/
# 让 meson 优雅缺席 2 个 ACL 测试(与 sleef 无 cmake 时同模式)。
ACL_OPT=""
if [ -d "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install" ]; then
    acl_tag=$(cat "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install/.glibc-build-tag" 2>/dev/null || echo host-unknown)
    if ! command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        # 尝试从挂载的 RPM 树自愈安装 cmake(supplement-cmake.sh 预下载)
        if ls /rpms/cmake-*.rpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "  ACL: 容器无 cmake, 从 /rpms 自愈安装..."
            rpm -Uvh --nodeps /rpms/cmake-*.rpm /rpms/cmake-data-*.rpm \\
                /rpms/cmake-filesystem-*.rpm /rpms/cmake-rpm-macros-*.rpm 2>/dev/null \\
              || rpm -Uvh --nodeps /rpms/cmake-*.aarch64.rpm 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi
    if [ "$acl_tag" = "$VENDORED_GLIBC" ] && [ -d "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install/lib" ]; then
        echo "  vendored ACL: install/ 是本容器 glibc $VENDORED_GLIBC 产物,复用"
    elif command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "  vendored ACL: install/ 构建于 glibc $acl_tag != $VENDORED_GLIBC,容器内重建..."
        rm -rf "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install" "$SRCW/third-party/acl/build"
        ( cd "$SRCW/third-party/acl" \\
          && "$TAR_BIN" xzf ComputeLibrary-23.02.tar.gz \\
          && bash build.sh )
        echo "$VENDORED_GLIBC" > "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install/.glibc-build-tag"
    else
        echo "  vendored ACL: 容器无 cmake 且 /rpms 无 cmake RPM,移除宿主产物(ACL 测试本镜像缺席)"
        rm -rf "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install"
    fi
fi
'''
assert old_acl_inner in s, "inner ACL block not found"
s = s.replace(old_acl_inner, new_acl_inner)

# ---- 改动 2: outer 的 ACL 头挂载/-Dacl_incdir 全部删除 ----
old_outer = '''# ACL(arithmetic_arm 测试)的 host 路径(bind 挂到同名位置, meson 用 -Dacl_incdir 找):
#   - 头: /home/sdc/root/arm64-sdc-fuzzing/third_party/arm-opt-install/include
#   - 库: /usr/lib64/libarm_compute.so
#   - clang-rt builtins: /usr/lib/clang/17/lib/aarch64-openEuler-linux-gnu/libclang_rt.builtins.a
# 仅当 host 上存在时挂载(24.03 容器镜像 == host 同 SP, 这些路径有效)。
# 24.03 传 -Dacl_incdir=<host path> 让 meson auto 找到 ACL 头;22.03/20.03 容器内
# 传 -Denable_acl=disabled(见 inner-build.sh)。
ACL_HDR="/home/sdc/root/arm64-sdc-fuzzing/third_party/arm-opt-install/include"
ACL_LIB="/usr/lib64"
CLANG_RT="/usr/lib/clang/17"
# ACL 头/incdir 仅 24.03 系列(容器镜像==host 同 SP,路径有效);22.03/20.03 传
# -Denable_acl=disabled(inner 脚本),不需要 ACL 头 — 挂载反而引入多系列并行时
# 对同一 host 目录的并发 :Z relabel 竞态。
if [ "$SERIES" = "24.03" ] && [ -d "$ACL_HDR" ]; then
    EXTRA_MESON+=("-Dacl_incdir=$ACL_HDR")
fi
EXTRA_MESON_STR="${EXTRA_MESON[*]:-}"
'''
new_outer = '''# ACL 已 vendor 到 third-party/acl(随 /src 挂载进容器, 容器内原生重建,
# 见 inner 脚本的 vendored ACL 段)。不再挂载 host 的 arm-opt-install 头树或
# /usr/lib64/libarm_compute.so, 也不再传 -Dacl_incdir。
# clang-rt builtins: host 路径(bind 挂到同名位置; 24.03 容器镜像==host 同 SP 有效)。
CLANG_RT="/usr/lib/clang/17"
EXTRA_MESON_STR="${EXTRA_MESON[*]:-}"
'''
assert old_outer in s, "outer ACL block not found"
s = s.replace(old_outer, new_outer)

# ---- 改动 3: 挂载段 ACL lib 挂载删除(保留 clang-rt) ----
old_mount = '''if [ "$SERIES" = "24.03" ] && [ -d "$ACL_HDR" ]; then
    MOUNTS+=(-v "$ACL_HDR:$ACL_HDR:ro,Z")
    [ -d "$ACL_LIB" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute.so:$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute.so:ro" -v "$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute_graph.so:$ACL_LIB/libarm_compute_graph.so:ro")
    [ -d "$CLANG_RT" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$CLANG_RT:$CLANG_RT:ro")
fi
'''
new_mount = '''# ACL: 无 host 挂载(third-party/acl 随 /src 进容器, 容器内重建)。
# 22.03/20.03: 挂载 cmake RPM(supplement-cmake.sh 预下到 rpms 树, 容器内自愈装)。
if [ -n "$OEU_MACRO" ] && ls "$RPMDIR_HOST"/cmake-*.rpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    MOUNTS+=(-v "$RPMDIR_HOST/cmake-$SERIES:$RPMDIR_HOST/cmake-$SERIES:ro,Z" 2>/dev/null) || true
fi
[ "$SERIES" = "24.03" ] && [ -d "$CLANG_RT" ] && MOUNTS+=(-v "$CLANG_RT:$CLANG_RT:ro")
'''
assert old_mount in s, "mount block not found"
s = s.replace(old_mount, new_mount)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("container-build.sh ACL rewritten")
PYEOF
bash -n scripts/offline-build/container-build.sh && echo "bash -n: OK"
input.description: Rewrite container-build.sh ACL sections

#!/bin/bash
# supplement-cmake.sh — 为 22.03/20.03 各 SP 的 RPM 子目录补充 cmake(ACL 容器内重建需要)。
#
# 背景: vendored ACL (third-party/acl, v23.02) 用 CMake 构建, 要求 cmake>=3.13。
# 24.03 容器镜像自带 cmake 3.2x, 但 22.03/20.03 离线镜像和 RPM 树都没有 cmake
# (与 sleef 的先例相同)。为了让 22.03/20.03 也能容器内原生重建 ACL(三 OS 全覆盖),
# 从各系列自己的 repo 下载该系列原版 cmake RPM 全家桶(cmake 主包 + data/filesystem/
# rpm-macros)到对应 rpms 子目录。容器内 container-build.sh 检测到 /rpms 里的
# cmake-*.rpm 后自愈安装(rpm -Uvh --nodeps), 随后 ACL 的重建逻辑即可走通。
#
# 依赖链(实测 rpm -qpR): libarchive/libcurl/libexpat/libjsoncpp/libuv/librhash —
# 均为各镜像基础包, --nodeps 安装即可用。
#
# 用法: ./supplement-cmake.sh [22.03|20.03|all]
#   默认 all: 处理 22.03 与 20.03 全部 SP 子目录(24.03 不需要)。
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
SRC_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

# 各系列的 repo 与 cmake 版本(2026-09-19 实查):
#   22.03 各 SP: cmake-3.22.0-9.oe2203sp{N}  (repo.openeuler.org/openEuler-22.03-LTS-SP{N})
#   20.03 各 SP: cmake-3.16.5-5.oe2003sp{N}  (repo.openeuler.org/openEuler-20.03-LTS-SP{N})
declare -A CMAKE_VER=(
    ["22.03"]="cmake-3.22.0-9"
    ["20.03"]="cmake-3.16.5-5"
)
declare -A CMAKE_SUBPKGS=(
    ["22.03"]="cmake-data cmake-filesystem cmake-rpm-macros"
    ["20.03"]="cmake-data cmake-filesystem cmake-rpm-macros"
)

download_one() {
    local url="$1" dest_dir="$2" pkg="$3"
    local out="$dest_dir/$pkg"
    if [ -f "$out" ] && [ "$(stat -c%s "$out" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" -gt 1000 ]; then
        echo "  ✓ $pkg (已存在)"
        return 0
    fi
    echo "  ↓ $pkg"
    if ! curl -sL "$url/$pkg" -o "$out" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "    FAILED 下载 $pkg" >&2
        rm -f "$out"
        return 1
    fi
    if file "$out" 2>/dev/null | grep -qi "HTML"; then
        echo "    错误: $pkg 下载得到的是 HTML(404?), 跳过" >&2
        rm -f "$out"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

supplement_series() {
    local series="$1"
    local base="third-party/rpms/openEuler-$series"
    local ver="${CMAKE_VER[$series]}"
    local sps
    sps=$(ls "$base" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^SP[0-9]+$|^LTS" || true)
    if [ -z "$sps" ]; then
        echo "警告: $base 下无 SP 子目录(rpms 子模块未 init?), 跳过 $series" >&2
        return 0
    fi
    for sp in $sps; do
        # repo tag 形如 openEuler-22.03-LTS-SP1 / openEuler-20.03-LTS-SP4 / LTS 本体
        local repotag="openEuler-$series-LTS-$sp"
        [ "$sp" = "LTS" ] && repotag="openEuler-$series-LTS"
        local url="https://repo.openeuler.org/$repotag/everything/aarch64/Packages"
        local dir="$base/$sp"
        echo "==> $series $sp  ($url)"
        download_one "$url" "$dir" "$ver.$(echo "$repotag" | tr 'A-Z-' 'a-z-').aarch64.rpm" || true
        for sub in ${CMAKE_SUBPKGS[$series]}; do
            download_one "$url" "$dir" "$sub-${ver#cmake-}.$(echo "$repotag" | tr 'A-Z-' 'a-z-').noarch.rpm" || true
        done
    done
}

case "${1:-all}" in
    22.03) supplement_series 22.03 ;;
    20.03) supplement_series 20.03 ;;
    all)
        supplement_series 22.03
        supplement_series 20.03
        ;;
    *) echo "用法: $0 [22.03|20.03|all]"; exit 1 ;;
esac
echo "==> 完成。容器构建时 container-build.sh 会检测 /rpms/cmake-*.rpm 自愈安装。"
