content.text: 发现两个 bug：(1) inner 的 glob `/rpms/cmake-*.rpm` **不递归**子目录（supplement 下载到 `$base/$sp/` 深层）；(2) supplement 下载的文件名 `openeuler-22.03-lts-sp1` 与真实 repo 命名 `oe2203sp1` **不一致**。修正两处——supplement 用**真实 repo 文件名**（`oe2203spN`），inner 用 `find` 深层查找：

input.command:
cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# 修正 1: supplement-cmake.sh 用真实 repo 文件名形态 (oe2203spN / oe2003spN)
p='scripts/offline-build/supplement-cmake.sh'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    for sp in $sps; do
        # repo tag 形如 openEuler-22.03-LTS-SP1 / openEuler-20.03-LTS-SP4 / LTS 本体
        local repotag="openEuler-$series-LTS-$sp"
        [ "$sp" = "LTS" ] && repotag="openEuler-$series-LTS"
        local url="https://repo.openeuler.org/$repotag/everything/aarch64/Packages"
        local dir="$base/$sp"
        echo "==> $series $sp  ($url)"
        download_one "$url" "$dir" "$ver.$(echo "$repotag" | tr 'A-Z-' 'a-z-').aarch64.rpm" || true
        for sub in ${CMAKE_SUBPKGS[$series]}; do
            download_one "$url" "$dir" "$sub-${ver#cmake-}.$(echo "$repotag" | tr 'A-Z-' 'a-z-').noarch.rpm" || true
        done
    done'''
new='''    for sp in $sps; do
        # repo tag 形如 openEuler-22.03-LTS-SP1 / openEuler-20.03-LTS-SP4 / LTS 本体;
        # RPM 文件名 release 段为 oe2203spN / oe2003spN 小写无点(实测 repo 列表)
        local repotag="openEuler-$series-LTS-$sp"
        [ "$sp" = "LTS" ] && repotag="openEuler-$series-LTS"
        local rel
        rel=$(echo "$repotag" | sed -E 's/openEuler-([0-9]+)\\.([0-9]+)-LTS(-SP([0-9]+))?/oe\\1\\2sp\\4/' | tr -d '-')
        # oe2203sp4 形态; LTS 本体无 SP 时 sed 已产出 oe2203sp (尾空) — 补成无 sp 后缀
        local rel2="${rel%sp}"
        local url="https://repo.openeuler.org/$repotag/everything/aarch64/Packages"
        local dir="$base/$sp"
        echo "==> $series $sp  (release: $rel2)"
        download_one "$url" "$dir" "$ver.$rel2.aarch64.rpm" || true
        for sub in ${CMAKE_SUBPKGS[$series]}; do
            download_one "$url" "$dir" "$sub-${ver#cmake-}.$rel2.noarch.rpm" || true
        done
    done'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("supplement fixed")

# 修正 2: container-build.sh inner 的 cmake RPM 查找用 find 递归
p2='scripts/offline-build/container-build.sh'
s2=open(p2).read()
old2='''    if ! command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        # 尝试从挂载的 RPM 树自愈安装 cmake(supplement-cmake.sh 预下载)
        if ls /rpms/cmake-*.rpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "  ACL: 容器无 cmake, 从 /rpms 自愈安装..."
            rpm -Uvh --nodeps /rpms/cmake-*.rpm /rpms/cmake-data-*.rpm \\
                /rpms/cmake-filesystem-*.rpm /rpms/cmake-rpm-macros-*.rpm 2>/dev/null \\
              || rpm -Uvh --nodeps /rpms/cmake-*.aarch64.rpm 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi'''
new2='''    if ! command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        # 尝试从挂载的 RPM 树自愈安装 cmake(supplement-cmake.sh 预下载到
        # 树的深层子目录, find 递归定位; --nodeps: 依赖均为镜像基础包)
        local cmake_main
        cmake_main=$(find /rpms -maxdepth 3 -name 'cmake-3*.aarch64.rpm' 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        if [ -n "$cmake_main" ]; then
            echo "  ACL: 容器无 cmake, 从 /rpms 自愈安装 ($(basename "$cmake_main"))..."
            local cmake_dir
            cmake_dir=$(dirname "$cmake_main")
            rpm -Uvh --nodeps "$cmake_main" "$cmake_dir"/cmake-data-*.rpm \\
                "$cmake_dir"/cmake-filesystem-*.rpm "$cmake_dir"/cmake-rpm-macros-*.rpm 2>/dev/null || true
            hash -r 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi'''
assert old2 in s2
s2=s2.replace(old2,new2)
open(p2,'w').write(s2)
print("container-build fixed")
PYEOF
bash -n scripts/offline-build/supplement-cmake.sh && bash -n scripts/offline-build/container-build.sh && echo "两个脚本 bash -n: OK"
input.description: Fix rpm naming and recursive find

Analyze ALL test cases in SDCShield (tests/common/ + tests/cpu/, both x86-64 reference and ARM64 port) and produce a defect list of tests whose implementation cannot actually stress / detect faults in the SDC unit they claim to cover — i.e., tests that pass trivially, stress the wrong thing, have vacuous golden comparisons, or misreport (pass/skip where they should do real work). Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) appended and complete; report at docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md. Fix ordering unchanged: D6 → D11 → D1/D2 → D3(acl) → eigen_svd_cdouble_sve/pocketfft-inverse.

Complete

- [x] Extract per-test metadata: name, quality_level, minimum_cpu, flags, description (DECLARE_TEST blocks)
- [x] Classify: x86-only / arm-only / common; real vs placeholder-skip vs stub
- [x] Record inventory in findings.md
- **Status:** complete

if [ -n "$FINDUTILS_RPM" ] && ! command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "  预装 findutils (镜像缺 find)..."
        rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force "$FINDUTILS_RPM" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
    command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: find 仍不可用" >&2; exit 1; }

    # 容器是最小化 KIWI 镜像, 系统包(util-linux/libuuid 等)版本与 RPM 树来源子版本号
    # 略有差异(如 -31 vs -39), dnf 的精确版本依赖会触发 "protected dnf" 死结。
    # 容器是可丢弃环境, 用 rpm --nodeps --force 直接强装整棵依赖树(等价于
    # install-deps.sh 的兜底方案 4), 依赖物理上都在 RPM 树里, 强装后能正常工作。
    EXCLUDE_RE='grub2|shim|mokutil|efivar|dracut|kpartx|fuse|glibc$|glibc-common|glibc-headers|glibc-static|systemd$|systemd-libs|systemd-udev|setup$|filesystem$|basesystem|shadow|pam|crypto-policies|openEuler-release|openEuler-gpg|openEuler-repos'
    KEEP=$(find "$RPMDIR" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.rpm' | grep -ivE "$EXCLUDE_RE")
    echo "  强装 $(echo "$KEEP" | wc -l) 个 RPM (--nodeps --force)..."
    rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force $KEEP >/tmp/rpm-install.log 2>&1 || true

    # 大批量 --nodeps --force 会因文件冲突静默跳过部分关键包(如 glibc-devel 提供
    # crt1.o, binutils 提供 ld)。显式重装这几个关键包, 保证 toolset gcc 能链接。
    # 注: 某些包(如 glibc-headers)在 20.03 不存在, ls 无匹配会非零退出 → 用 || true
    # 兜底, 否则 set -e 会中断脚本。
    for mustpkg in glibc-devel glibc-headers binutils gcc-toolset-10-gcc gcc-toolset-10-gcc-c++ gcc-toolset-10-libstdc++-devel gcc-toolset-10-libgcc; do
        f=$(ls "$RPMDIR"/${mustpkg}-*.rpm 2>/dev/null | head -1) || true
        [ -n "$f" ] && rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    done
    echo "  安装完成; gcc 版本: $(gcc --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo MISSING)"

    # 20.03 + 22.03 的最小镜像缺 ld 符号链接: binutils 装了 ld.bfd 但
    # /usr/bin/ld → /etc/alternatives/ld 的 alternatives 链未建(--nodeps 跳了
    # %post 脚本依赖的 chkconfig/alternatives)。手动建直链, 让 collect2 找到 ld。
    if [ ! -e /usr/bin/ld ] && [ -e /usr/bin/ld.bfd ]; then
        ln -sf /usr/bin/ld.bfd /usr/bin/ld
        echo "  建 /usr/bin/ld → ld.bfd 符号链接"
    fi
fi

# ld 符号链接兜底对"镜像烘焙分支"同样必要: 烘焙镜像(依赖已就绪跳过安装)也可能缺
# /usr/bin/ld(尤其 20.03-SP4 这种 toolset 靠自愈强装的场景, collect2 需要系统 ld)。

content.text: 清楚了——容器内已有“强装整棵 RPM 树”的自愈机制（`rpm -Uvh --nodeps --force $KEEP`，RPMDIR 顶层所有 rpm）。**最优解**：supplement 下载的 cmake RPM 应放到 **RPMDIR 顶层**（与其它包同级），让既有机制统一处理；且需补齐 `libjsoncpp` 等依赖包。修改方案收敛为：supplement-cmake.sh 把 cmake 全家桶 + jsoncpp 依赖下到**顶层**，container-build.sh 的 ACL 段简化为“无 cmake 时提示运行 supplement 脚本后重试，或优雅缺席”：

input.command: cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; echo "=== RPMDIR 在 container-build 里如何定义(顶层=哪) ==="; grep -n "RPMDIR\b\|RPMDIR=" scripts/offline-build/container-build.sh | head -8; echo; echo "=== jsoncpp 在 22.03 repo ==="; timeout 30 curl -sL "https://repo.openeuler.org/openEuler-22.03-LTS-SP4/everything/aarch64/Packages/" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '"(libjsoncpp|jsoncpp)[^"]*"' | sort -u | head -3; echo; echo "=== 20.03 repo cmake 依赖里有没有 jsoncpp ==="; timeout 30 curl -sL "https://repo.openeuler.org/openEuler-20.03-LTS-SP4/everything/aarch64/Packages/" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '"(cmake|libjsoncpp|jsoncpp)[^"]*"' | sort -u | head -6

## Goal
Analyze ALL test cases in SDCShield (tests/common/ + tests/cpu/, both x86-64 reference and ARM64 port) and produce a defect list of tests whose implementation cannot actually stress / detect faults in the SDC unit they claim to cover — i.e., tests that pass trivially, stress the wrong thing, have vacuous golden comparisons, or misreport (pass/skip where they should do real work). ## Next Step
Phase 5 (library stress-coverage) appended and complete; report at docs/SDC_LIBRARY_STRESS_COVERAGE_AUDIT_2026-09-18.md. Fix ordering unchanged: D6 → D11 → D1/D2 → D3(acl) → eigen_svd_cdouble_sve/pocketfft-inverse.

Complete

content.text: 依赖清单完整（22.03 需 jsoncpp；20.03 的 libarchive 等基础包镜像里应该已有——`KEEP` 强装机制会带上）。**最终设计**（简洁可靠）：supplement 下载到 **RPMDIR 顶层**（与 findutils 同级），既有 `KEEP` 强装机制自动包含 cmake+jsoncpp；我的 inner ACL 段删掉自装逻辑，只留“无 cmake 则优雅缺席”。收敛改造：

input.command:
cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='scripts/offline-build/container-build.sh'
s=open(p).read()
# inner ACL 段: 删自装 cmake 逻辑(KEEP 强装已覆盖顶层 rpm), 无 cmake 则缺席
old='''ACL_OPT=""
if [ -d "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install" ]; then
    acl_tag=$(cat "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install/.glibc-build-tag" 2>/dev/null || echo host-unknown)
    if ! command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        # 尝试从挂载的 RPM 树自愈安装 cmake(supplement-cmake.sh 预下载到
        # 树的深层子目录, find 递归定位; --nodeps: 依赖均为镜像基础包)
        cmake_main=$(find /rpms -maxdepth 3 -name 'cmake-3*.aarch64.rpm' 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
        if [ -n "$cmake_main" ]; then
            echo "  ACL: 容器无 cmake, 从 /rpms 自愈安装 ($(basename "$cmake_main"))..."
            cmake_dir=$(dirname "$cmake_main")
            rpm -Uvh --nodeps "$cmake_main" "$cmake_dir"/cmake-data-*.rpm \\
                "$cmake_dir"/cmake-filesystem-*.rpm "$cmake_dir"/cmake-rpm-macros-*.rpm 2>/dev/null || true
            hash -r 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi
    if [ "$acl_tag" = "$VENDORED_GLIBC" ] && [ -d "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install/lib" ]; then
        echo "  vendored ACL: install/ 是本容器 glibc $VENDORED_GLIBC 产物,复用"
    elif command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "  vendored ACL: install/ 构建于 glibc $acl_tag != $VENDORED_GLIBC,容器内重建..."
        rm -rf "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install" "$SRCW/third-party/acl/build"
        ( cd "$SRCW/third-party/acl" \\
          && "$TAR_BIN" xzf ComputeLibrary-23.02.tar.gz \\
          && bash build.sh )
        echo "$VENDORED_GLIBC" > "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install/.glibc-build-tag"
    else
        echo "  vendored ACL: 容器无 cmake 且 /rpms 无 cmake RPM,移除宿主产物(ACL 测试本镜像缺席)"
        rm -rf "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install"
    fi
fi
'''
new='''ACL_OPT=""
if [ -d "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install" ]; then
    acl_tag=$(cat "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install/.glibc-build-tag" 2>/dev/null || echo host-unknown)
    if [ "$acl_tag" = "$VENDORED_GLIBC" ] && [ -d "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install/lib" ]; then
        echo "  vendored ACL: install/ 是本容器 glibc $VENDORED_GLIBC 产物,复用"
    elif command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "  vendored ACL: install/ 构建于 glibc $acl_tag != $VENDORED_GLIBC,容器内重建..."
        rm -rf "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install" "$SRCW/third-party/acl/build"
        ( cd "$SRCW/third-party/acl" \\
          && "$TAR_BIN" xzf ComputeLibrary-23.02.tar.gz \\
          && bash build.sh )
        echo "$VENDORED_GLIBC" > "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install/.glibc-build-tag"
    else
        echo "  vendored ACL: 容器无 cmake(22.03/20.03 需先在有网机跑 supplement-cmake.sh 下 RPM 到 rpms 树顶层),移除宿主产物(ACL 测试本镜像缺席)"
        rm -rf "$SRCW/third-party/acl/install"
    fi
fi
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("inner simplified")
PYEOF
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# supplement: 下载目标改为 rpms 树顶层(与 findutils 等同级), KEEP 强装机制自动覆盖
p='scripts/offline-build/supplement-cmake.sh'
s=open(p).read()
old='''        # 动态解析该 repo 的实际 cmake 版本(release 段各 SP 不同, 如 22.03 LTS
        # 是 3.22.0-4 而 SP4 是 3.22.0-9); 解析失败回退到本系列已知版本
        local ver_live
        ver_live=$(curl -sL "$url/" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '"cmake-[0-9.]+-[0-9]+\\.'"$rel2"'\\.aarch64\\.rpm"' | head -1 | tr -d '"' | sed 's/\\.aarch64\\.rpm//')
        [ -z "$ver_live" ] && ver_live="$ver.$rel2"
        echo "==> $series $sp  (release: $rel2, cmake: ${ver_live#cmake-})"
        download_one "$url" "$dir" "$ver_live.aarch64.rpm" || true
        for sub in ${CMAKE_SUBPKGS[$series]}; do
            download_one "$url" "$dir" "$sub-${ver_live#cmake-}.noarch.rpm" || true
        done'''
new='''        # 动态解析该 repo 的实际 cmake 版本(release 段各 SP 不同, 如 22.03 LTS
        # 是 3.22.0-4 而 SP4 是 3.22.0-9); 解析失败回退到本系列已知版本
        local ver_live
        ver_live=$(curl -sL "$url/" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '"cmake-[0-9.]+-[0-9]+\\.'"$rel2"'\\.aarch64\\.rpm"' | head -1 | tr -d '"' | sed 's/\\.aarch64\\.rpm//')
        [ -z "$ver_live" ] && ver_live="$ver.$rel2"
        # 下载目标: rpms 树顶层(与 findutils 等同级)。container-build.sh 的
        # [1/5] 段 KEEP 强装(find "$RPMDIR" -maxdepth 1)会自动把 cmake 全家桶
        # 连同 jsoncpp 依赖一起装进容器 — 不需要单独的自装逻辑。
        # 22.03 的 cmake 主二进制额外依赖 libjsoncpp.so.25(20.03 不需要), 从
        # 同 repo 一并下载 jsoncpp 主包。
        local top="$base"
        echo "==> $series $sp  (release: $rel2, cmake: ${ver_live#cmake-} → 顶层)"
        download_one "$url" "$top" "$ver_live.aarch64.rpm" || true
        for sub in ${CMAKE_SUBPKGS[$series]}; do
            download_one "$url" "$top" "$sub-${ver_live#cmake-}.noarch.rpm" || true
        done
        [ "$series" = "22.03" ] && download_one "$url" "$top" "jsoncpp-1.9.5-5.$rel2.aarch64.rpm" || true
        '''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("supplement targets top level")
PYEOF
bash -n scripts/offline-build/container-build.sh && bash -n scripts/offline-build/supplement-cmake.sh && echo "两个脚本 bash -n OK"
input.description: Simplify inner ACL, retarget supplement to top level

content.text: 差异确认：`cmake-filesystem` 在 22.03 是 **aarch64**（非 noarch），`jsoncpp` release 是 **1.9.5-3**（非 -5）。改 supplement 为**动态解析所有包名**（不再猜），重跑验证：

input.command:
cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='scripts/offline-build/supplement-cmake.sh'
s=open(p).read()
old='''        local top="$base"
        echo "==> $series $sp  (release: $rel2, cmake: ${ver_live#cmake-} → 顶层)"
        download_one "$url" "$top" "$ver_live.aarch64.rpm" || true
        for sub in ${CMAKE_SUBPKGS[$series]}; do
            download_one "$url" "$top" "$sub-${ver_live#cmake-}.noarch.rpm" || true
        done
        [ "$series" = "22.03" ] && download_one "$url" "$top" "jsoncpp-1.9.5-5.$rel2.aarch64.rpm" || true
        '''
new='''        local top="$base"
        echo "==> $series $sp  (release: $rel2, cmake: ${ver_live#cmake-} → 顶层)"
        download_one "$url" "$top" "$ver_live.aarch64.rpm" || true
        # 子包与依赖的 release 段/arch 各 repo 不一(cmake-filesystem 在 22.03-LTS
        # 是 aarch64, jsoncpp release 是 -3 而非 -5) — 一律从 repo 列表页动态解析,
        # 解析不到则跳过(容器内 KEEP 强装容忍缺个别子包)
        for sub in ${CMAKE_SUBPKGS[$series]} jsoncpp; do
            subfile=$(curl -sL "$url/" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '"'\"$sub\"'-[0-9][^"]*\\.(aarch64|noarch)\\.rpm"' | grep -vE 'devel|help|gui' | head -1 | tr -d '"')
            [ -n "$subfile" ] && download_one "$url" "$top" "$subfile" || true
        done
        '''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("dynamic subpkg resolution")
PYEOF
bash -n scripts/offline-build/supplement-cmake.sh && rm -f third-party/rpms/openEuler-22.03/*.rpm && bash scripts/offline-build/supplement-cmake.sh 22.03 2>&1 | grep -E "==>|✓|↓" | head -10; echo; ls third-party/rpms/openEuler-22.03/*.rpm

content.text: **Task 3 完整闭环**：cmake 3.22.0 真实可跑 + configure OK。清理测试残留（rpms 是 git 子模块目录——下载的 rpm 不该留在工作树里，它们属于“有网机器预下”的产物），提交 Task 3：

input.command:
cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield; rm -rf third-party/rpms/openEuler-22.03/LTS third-party/rpms/openEuler-22.03/*.rpm /tmp/cmake-test /tmp/cmake-sim; git status --short scripts/ third-party/rpms/; echo "---"; git add scripts/offline-build/container-build.sh scripts/offline-build/supplement-cmake.sh && git commit -m "build(acl): container-native ACL rebuild for all three OSes — drop the ACL hacks

Replace the host-binary ACL scheme in the offline container build with
container-native rebuilds of the vendored ACL (third-party/acl, v23.02),
the same glibc-tag pattern as openssl/openblas/sleef:

- container-build.sh inner script: when third-party/acl/install's
  glibc-build-tag differs from the container's glibc, rebuild ACL inside
  the container (tar + build.sh; gcc>=10.2 is satisfied by 24.03 system
  gcc 12.3, 22.03 system gcc 10.3, and 20.03's activated gcc-toolset-10).
  When the container has no cmake (22.03/20.03 minimal images), the ACL
  install tree is removed and the 2 ACL tests degrade gracefully with a
  message — same pattern as sleef.
- container-build.sh outer script: the ACL host-path mount hack is gone
  (no more -Dacl_incdir, no bind-mounting /home/sdc/root/.../arm-opt-install
  headers or /usr/lib64/libarm_compute.so, which was the source of the
  cross-series concurrent :Z relabel races). CLANG_RT mount is kept.
- NEW scripts/offline-build/supplement-cmake.sh: downloads the cmake
  RPM set (cmake + data/filesystem/rpm-macros + the jsoncpp runtime dep)
  from each series' own openEuler repo into the rpms tree TOP LEVEL, so
  the existing [1/5] KEEP force-install pass (find \$RPMDIR -maxdepth 1)
  picks them up automatically — no separate cmake install logic needed.
  Filenames are dynamically resolved from the repo listing (release
  segments differ per SP: 22.03-LTS is 3.22.0-4.oe2203 while SP4 is
  3.22.0-9.oe2203sp4; cmake-filesystem is aarch64 in 22.03, noarch in
  20.03; jsoncpp release is -3 not -5 — all verified against the repo).
  Run once on a networked machine: ./supplement-cmake.sh [22.03|20.03|all].

Verified on openEuler 24.03 SP4 aarch64 (Kunpeng 920):
- bash -n on both scripts: OK
- supplement-cmake.sh 22.03 real run: all 5 RPMs downloaded to the rpms
  tree top level (cmake-3.22.0-4.oe2203.aarch64.rpm 9.4MB, cmake-data,
  cmake-filesystem, cmake-rpm-macros, jsoncpp-1.9.5-3.oe2203.aarch64.rpm)
- simulated container install (rpm2cpio extract of all 5 RPMs +
  LD_LIBRARY_PATH): cmake 3.22.0 runs and configures a >=3.13 project —
  the exact operation the ACL rebuild performs
- graceful path: with the rpms submodule not initialized the script
  warns and exits 0
- host build non-regression: ninja -C builddir — no work to do (the
  host build never enters the container code path)

Container end-to-end runs (20.03/22.03/24.03 podman builds) require a
podman host and an initialized rpms submodule, neither available on
this machine — the plan records them as follow-up validation." && git push 2>&1 | tail -2
